+// 多个逻辑版本的见证：两个根的 key 集合不同（用户在旧根之后写出了新 key），一个读者拿着旧版本，不变量照样成立；
+// 防止「所有视图共享同一份逻辑内容」那一形回来，也防止历史定理只在空映射上成立。
+pub proof fn witness_two_logical_versions_and_an_old_reader_satisfy_the_invariant()
+    ensures
+        exists|state: RunRingState|
+            #[trigger] every_protected_view_reads_right(state) && state.roots.len() == 2 && state.readers.len() == 1
+                && state.roots[0].view.logical.dom() != state.roots[1].view.logical.dom(),
+{
+    let old_view = RunView {
+        mapping: Map::<u64, SlotRun>::empty().insert(7u64, SlotRun { start: 10, span: 1 }),
+        logical: Map::<u64, Seq<Seq<u8>>>::empty().insert(7u64, seq![seq![1u8]]),
+    };
+    let new_view = RunView {
+        mapping: Map::<u64, SlotRun>::empty().insert(7u64, SlotRun { start: 10, span: 1 }).insert(
+            8u64,
+            SlotRun { start: 11, span: 2 },
+        ),
+        logical: Map::<u64, Seq<Seq<u8>>>::empty().insert(7u64, seq![seq![1u8]]).insert(8u64, seq![seq![2u8], seq![3u8]]),
+    };
+    let state = ring_state_of(
+        Map::<int, Seq<u8>>::empty().insert(10int, seq![1u8]).insert(11int, seq![2u8]).insert(12int, seq![3u8]),
+        seq![
+            RingRoot { view: old_view, name: RootName::UserVersion { version: 0 } },
+            RingRoot { view: new_view, name: RootName::UserVersion { version: 1 } },
+        ],
+        0,
+        0,
+        new_view,
+        seq![old_view],
+        2,
+        2,
+    );
+    assert(old_view.mapping.dom() =~= old_view.logical.dom());
+    assert(new_view.mapping.dom() =~= new_view.logical.dom());
+    assert(run_bytes_on_disk(state.disk, old_view.mapping[7u64]) =~= seq![seq![1u8]]);
+    assert(run_is_on_disk(state.disk, new_view.mapping[8u64])) by {
+        assert forall|offset: int| 0 <= offset < 2 implies state.disk.contains_key(#[trigger] (11int + offset)) by {
+            assert(offset == 0 || offset == 1);
+        }
+    }
+    assert(run_bytes_on_disk(state.disk, new_view.mapping[8u64]) =~= seq![seq![2u8], seq![3u8]]);
+    assert(view_reads_its_logical_content(old_view, state.disk));
+    assert(view_reads_its_logical_content(new_view, state.disk)) by {
+        assert forall|key: u64| new_view.mapping.contains_key(key) implies run_is_on_disk(state.disk, #[trigger] new_view.mapping[key])
+            && new_view.logical[key] == run_bytes_on_disk(state.disk, new_view.mapping[key]) by {
+            if key == 8u64 {
+            } else {
+                assert(key == 7u64);
+                assert(run_bytes_on_disk(state.disk, new_view.mapping[key]) =~= seq![seq![1u8]]);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    assert(state.roots[0].view == old_view);
+    assert(state.roots[1].view == new_view);
+    assert(state.readers[0] == old_view);
+    assert(every_protected_view_reads_right(state));
+    assert(!(old_view.logical.dom() =~= new_view.logical.dom())) by {
+        assert(new_view.logical.dom().contains(8u64));
+        assert(!old_view.logical.dom().contains(8u64));
+    }
+}
+
+
+// ===== G7：整理对用户看得见的东西的效应 =====
+// 判决 research/prompts/m4-exit5-relocation-proof-r3-main-verification.md 第二节 Z1 第二行（D13 已定项 18 性质那一句）：整理不改现行内容；
+// 回退候选集是不整理那份的后缀、至多少 k 个，抬 F 的上限恰多 k（k 为这一段整理占的发布数），按版本号点名。
+// 这一层只留用户看得见的：根的逻辑内容与名字、内存 F、现行内容、根环容量与下一个版本号。整理那几步里不发布的（写目的地、换映射、回收）
+// 与读者不改这一层，整理的发布在这一层上是「推一个不带版本号的根」；见 lemma_run_ring_steps_project_onto_the_observed_operations。
+// 只说两份都接受了每一步的不崩溃历史：同一步两份都拒的是两边的空操作，删掉它不改结论；不整理那份接受、整理那份拒的
+// 就是候选移出窗口本身，之后两份不再是同一串用户历史。整理那份接受、不整理那份拒的从不出现
+// （lemma_compaction_never_admits_an_operation_the_plain_history_refuses）。
+pub struct RingObservation {
+    pub roots: Seq<ObservedRoot>,
+    pub in_memory_floor: nat,
+    pub head_logical: Map<u64, Seq<Seq<u8>>>,
+    pub window: nat,
+    pub next_user_version: nat,
+}
+
+pub enum UserOperation {
+    Publish { logical: Map<u64, Seq<Seq<u8>>> },
+    Checkpoint,
+    Rollback { version: nat },
+    RaiseFloor { version: nat },
+}
+
+pub open spec fn observation_of(
+    roots: Seq<ObservedRoot>,
+    in_memory_floor: nat,
+    head_logical: Map<u64, Seq<Seq<u8>>>,
+    window: nat,
+    next_user_version: nat,
+) -> RingObservation {
+    RingObservation { roots, in_memory_floor, head_logical, window, next_user_version }
+}
+
+pub open spec fn observe_the_run_ring(state: RunRingState) -> RingObservation {
+    observation_of(
+        observed_roots_of(state.roots),
+        state.in_memory_floor,
+        state.head.logical,
+        state.window,
+        state.next_user_version,
+    )
+}
+
+pub open spec fn observed_floor_after_a_checkpoint(observation: RingObservation) -> nat {
+    if observation.roots.len() + 1 - observation.in_memory_floor > observation.window {
+        (observation.in_memory_floor + 1) as nat
+    } else {
+        observation.in_memory_floor
+    }
+}
+
+pub open spec fn user_operation_is_accepted(observation: RingObservation, operation: UserOperation) -> bool {
+    match operation {
+        UserOperation::Publish { logical: _ } => true,
+        UserOperation::Checkpoint => true,
+        UserOperation::Rollback { version } => version_is_a_candidate(
+            observation.roots,
+            observation.in_memory_floor,
+            version,
+        ),
+        UserOperation::RaiseFloor { version } => version_is_a_candidate(
+            observation.roots,
+            observation.in_memory_floor,
+            version,
+        ),
+    }
+}
+
+pub open spec fn observation_after_user_operation(observation: RingObservation, operation: UserOperation) -> RingObservation {
+    match operation {
+        UserOperation::Publish { logical } => observation_of(
+            observation.roots,
+            observation.in_memory_floor,
+            logical,
+            observation.window,
+            observation.next_user_version,
+        ),
+        UserOperation::Checkpoint => observation_of(
+            observation.roots.push(
+                ObservedRoot {
+                    logical: observation.head_logical,
+                    name: RootName::UserVersion { version: observation.next_user_version },
+                },
+            ),
+            observed_floor_after_a_checkpoint(observation),
+            observation.head_logical,
+            observation.window,
+            observation.next_user_version + 1,
+        ),
+        UserOperation::Rollback { version } => observation_of(
+            observation.roots,
+            observation.in_memory_floor,
+            observation.roots[index_of_the_candidate_version(
+                observation.roots,
+                observation.in_memory_floor,
+                version,
+            )].logical,
+            observation.window,
+            observation.next_user_version,
+        ),
+        UserOperation::RaiseFloor { version } => observation_of(
+            observation.roots,
+            index_of_the_candidate_version(observation.roots, observation.in_memory_floor, version) as nat,
+            observation.head_logical,
+            observation.window,
+            observation.next_user_version,
+        ),
+    }
+}
+
+pub open spec fn observation_after_a_compaction_publish(observation: RingObservation) -> RingObservation {
+    observation_of(
+        observation.roots.push(ObservedRoot { logical: observation.head_logical, name: RootName::CompactionPublish }),
+        observed_floor_after_a_checkpoint(observation),
+        observation.head_logical,
+        observation.window,
+        observation.next_user_version,
+    )
+}
+
+// 根环的每一步在用户看得见的那一层上是什么：不发布的步骤（写、回收、搬迁、读者取得与释放）不改这一层；用户发布、两种发布、
+// 按版本号回退与只在内存里抬 F 各是这一层的一步，根环允许的这一层也接受。崩溃不在 G7 里。
+pub proof fn lemma_run_ring_steps_project_onto_the_observed_operations(state: RunRingState, step: RunRingStep)
+    ensures
+        match step {
+            RunRingStep::Write { slot: _, bytes: _ } => observe_the_run_ring(run_ring_next(state, step)) == observe_the_run_ring(state),
+            RunRingStep::Reclaim { slot: _ } => observe_the_run_ring(run_ring_next(state, step)) == observe_the_run_ring(state),
+            RunRingStep::Relocate { key: _, destination: _ } => observe_the_run_ring(run_ring_next(state, step))
+                == observe_the_run_ring(state),
+            RunRingStep::UserPublish { new_view } => observe_the_run_ring(run_ring_next(state, step))
+                == observation_after_user_operation(
+                observe_the_run_ring(state),
+                UserOperation::Publish { logical: new_view.logical },
+            ),
+            RunRingStep::UserCheckpoint => observe_the_run_ring(run_ring_next(state, step)) == observation_after_user_operation(
+                observe_the_run_ring(state),
+                UserOperation::Checkpoint,
+            ),
+            RunRingStep::CompactionCheckpoint => observe_the_run_ring(run_ring_next(state, step))
+                == observation_after_a_compaction_publish(observe_the_run_ring(state)),
+            RunRingStep::Rollback { version } => {
+                &&& run_ring_step_is_enabled(state, step) == user_operation_is_accepted(
+                    observe_the_run_ring(state),
+                    UserOperation::Rollback { version },
+                )
+                &&& (run_ring_step_is_enabled(state, step) ==> observe_the_run_ring(run_ring_next(state, step))
+                    == observation_after_user_operation(observe_the_run_ring(state), UserOperation::Rollback { version }))
+            },
+            RunRingStep::RaiseFloorInMemory { version } => {
+                &&& run_ring_step_is_enabled(state, step) == user_operation_is_accepted(
+                    observe_the_run_ring(state),
+                    UserOperation::RaiseFloor { version },
+                )
+                &&& observe_the_run_ring(run_ring_next(state, step)) == observation_after_user_operation(
+                    observe_the_run_ring(state),
+                    UserOperation::RaiseFloor { version },
+                )
+            },
+            RunRingStep::AcquireReader => observe_the_run_ring(run_ring_next(state, step)) == observe_the_run_ring(state),
+            RunRingStep::ReleaseReader { index: _ } => observe_the_run_ring(run_ring_next(state, step))
+                == observe_the_run_ring(state),
+            RunRingStep::Crash => true,
+        },
+{
+    let after = run_ring_next(state, step);
+    lemma_observed_roots_keep_each_root(state.roots);
+    match step {
+        RunRingStep::UserCheckpoint => {
+            assert(observed_roots_of(after.roots) =~= observed_roots_of(state.roots).push(
+                ObservedRoot { logical: state.head.logical, name: RootName::UserVersion { version: state.next_user_version } },
+            ));
+        },
+        RunRingStep::CompactionCheckpoint => {
+            assert(observed_roots_of(after.roots) =~= observed_roots_of(state.roots).push(
+                ObservedRoot { logical: state.head.logical, name: RootName::CompactionPublish },
+            ));
+        },
+        RunRingStep::Rollback { version } => {
+            if run_ring_step_is_enabled(state, step) {
+                let target = index_of_user_version(state.roots, state.in_memory_floor, version);
+                assert(state.in_memory_floor <= target < state.roots.len());
+                assert(observed_roots_of(state.roots)[target] == observed_root_of(state.roots[target]));
+            }
+        },
+        RunRingStep::Write { slot: _, bytes: _ } => {},
+        RunRingStep::Reclaim { slot: _ } => {},
+        RunRingStep::Relocate { key: _, destination: _ } => {},
+        RunRingStep::UserPublish { new_view: _ } => {},
+        RunRingStep::RaiseFloorInMemory { version: _ } => {},
+        RunRingStep::AcquireReader => {},
+        RunRingStep::ReleaseReader { index: _ } => {},
+        RunRingStep::Crash => {},
+    }
+}
+
+pub open spec fn observation_is_shaped(observation: RingObservation) -> bool {
+    &&& observation.roots.len() >= 1
+    &&& observation.in_memory_floor < observation.roots.len()
+    &&& observation.window >= 1
+    &&& observation.roots.len() - observation.in_memory_floor <= observation.window
+}
+
+pub open spec fn version_of_root(root: ObservedRoot) -> nat {
+    match root.name {
+        RootName::UserVersion { version } => version,
+        RootName::CompactionPublish => 0,
+    }
+}
+
+// 不整理那份的每个根都是用户发布的，版本号按根环次序严格升、都小于下一个版本号：按版本号点名恰点到一个根。
+pub open spec fn every_root_is_a_user_version_in_order(observation: RingObservation) -> bool {
+    &&& forall|index: int| 0 <= index < observation.roots.len() ==> (#[trigger] observation.roots[index]).name is UserVersion
+    &&& forall|index: int| 0 <= index < observation.roots.len() ==> version_of_root(#[trigger] observation.roots[index])
+        < observation.next_user_version
+    &&& forall|earlier: int, later: int|
+        #![trigger observation.roots[earlier], observation.roots[later]]
+        0 <= earlier < later < observation.roots.len() ==> version_of_root(observation.roots[earlier]) < version_of_root(
+            observation.roots[later],
+        )
+}
+
+// 抬 F 能抬到的最高下标（最后一个根）。
+pub open spec fn raise_floor_ceiling(observation: RingObservation) -> int {
+    observation.roots.len() - 1
+}
+
+// 不整理那份与整理那份之间的对应：position 把不整理那份的每个根送到整理那份里同内容、同版本号的根，按原次序；
+// oldest_still_shown 是不整理那份里第一个在整理那份回退候选里的根。各条的意思写在行尾那一句里。
+pub open spec fn compaction_relation(
+    without_compaction: RingObservation,
+    with_compaction: RingObservation,
+    compaction_publishes: nat,
+    position: Seq<int>,
+    oldest_still_shown: int,
+) -> bool {
+    &&& observation_is_shaped(without_compaction)
+    &&& observation_is_shaped(with_compaction)
+    &&& every_root_is_a_user_version_in_order(without_compaction)
+    // 整理不改现行内容
+    &&& with_compaction.head_logical == without_compaction.head_logical
+    &&& with_compaction.window == without_compaction.window
+    &&& with_compaction.next_user_version == without_compaction.next_user_version
+    // 抬 F 的上限恰多 k
+    &&& raise_floor_ceiling(with_compaction) == raise_floor_ceiling(without_compaction) + compaction_publishes
+    // 不整理那份的根按原次序、同内容同版本号出现在整理那份里；整理那份里带版本号的根都是这样来的
+    &&& position.len() == without_compaction.roots.len()
+    &&& forall|index: int|
+        0 <= index < position.len() ==> 0 <= #[trigger] position[index] < with_compaction.roots.len()
+            && with_compaction.roots[position[index]] == without_compaction.roots[index]
+    &&& forall|earlier: int, later: int|
+        #![trigger position[earlier], position[later]]
+        0 <= earlier < later < position.len() ==> position[earlier] < position[later]
+    &&& forall|with_index: int|
+        0 <= with_index < with_compaction.roots.len() && (#[trigger] with_compaction.roots[with_index]).name is UserVersion
+            ==> exists|index: int| 0 <= index < position.len() && #[trigger] position[index] == with_index
+    // 回退候选是不整理那份的后缀：整理那份的候选里带版本号的，恰是不整理那份候选从 oldest_still_shown 起的那一截
+    &&& without_compaction.in_memory_floor <= oldest_still_shown <= without_compaction.roots.len()
+    &&& forall|index: int|
+        0 <= index < position.len() ==> (with_compaction.in_memory_floor <= #[trigger] position[index] <==> oldest_still_shown
+            <= index)
+    // 至多少 k 个
+    &&& oldest_still_shown - without_compaction.in_memory_floor <= compaction_publishes
+    // 归纳用：不整理那份候选里的根数不多于整理那份（整理那份多出来的都是整理的发布）
+    &&& without_compaction.roots.len() - without_compaction.in_memory_floor <= with_compaction.roots.len()
+        - with_compaction.in_memory_floor
+}
+
+pub open spec fn compaction_keeps_what_the_user_sees(
+    without_compaction: RingObservation,
+    with_compaction: RingObservation,
+    compaction_publishes: nat,
+) -> bool {
+    exists|position: Seq<int>, oldest_still_shown: int|
+        #[trigger] compaction_relation(without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown)
+}
+
+// 严格升的下标序列，两项之间的差不小于它们在序列里隔开的距离。
+pub proof fn lemma_strictly_increasing_positions_spread_out(position: Seq<int>, earlier: int, later: int)
+    requires
+        0 <= earlier <= later < position.len(),
+        forall|this_index: int, that_index: int|
+            #![trigger position[this_index], position[that_index]]
+            0 <= this_index < that_index < position.len() ==> position[this_index] < position[that_index],
+    ensures
+        position[later] - position[earlier] >= later - earlier,
+    decreases later - earlier,
+{
+    if earlier < later {
+        lemma_strictly_increasing_positions_spread_out(position, earlier, later - 1);
+        assert(position[later - 1] < position[later]);
+    }
+}
+
+// 从对应关系推出的三件计数：oldest_still_shown 不超过整理那份的内存 F；整理那份的候选至少装得下不整理那份从 oldest_still_shown 起的根；
+// 两个数相等时整理那份最旧的候选就是 oldest_still_shown 那个根。
+pub proof fn lemma_the_compaction_relation_counts(
+    without_compaction: RingObservation,
+    with_compaction: RingObservation,
+    compaction_publishes: nat,
+    position: Seq<int>,
+    oldest_still_shown: int,
+)
+    requires
+        compaction_relation(without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown),
+    ensures
+        oldest_still_shown <= with_compaction.in_memory_floor,
+        with_compaction.roots.len() - with_compaction.in_memory_floor >= without_compaction.roots.len() - oldest_still_shown,
+        oldest_still_shown < without_compaction.roots.len() && with_compaction.roots.len() - with_compaction.in_memory_floor
+            == without_compaction.roots.len() - oldest_still_shown ==> position[oldest_still_shown] == with_compaction.in_memory_floor,
+        oldest_still_shown < without_compaction.roots.len() ==> position[oldest_still_shown] >= with_compaction.in_memory_floor,
+{
+    let length = without_compaction.roots.len() as int;
+    if oldest_still_shown > 0 {
+        lemma_strictly_increasing_positions_spread_out(position, 0, oldest_still_shown - 1);
+        assert(position[0] >= 0);
+        assert(!(oldest_still_shown <= oldest_still_shown - 1));
+        assert(position[oldest_still_shown - 1] < with_compaction.in_memory_floor);
+    }
+    if oldest_still_shown < length {
+        lemma_strictly_increasing_positions_spread_out(position, oldest_still_shown, length - 1);
+        assert(position[length - 1] < with_compaction.roots.len());
+        assert(position[oldest_still_shown] >= with_compaction.in_memory_floor);
+    }
+}
+
+// 不整理那份按版本号点到的根，在整理那份里就是它的对应根；整理那份接受了的点名，不整理那份也接受。
+pub proof fn lemma_a_version_named_in_the_compacted_history_is_the_corresponding_root(
+    without_compaction: RingObservation,
+    with_compaction: RingObservation,
+    compaction_publishes: nat,
+    position: Seq<int>,
+    oldest_still_shown: int,
+    version: nat,
+)
+    requires
+        compaction_relation(without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown),
+        version_is_a_candidate(with_compaction.roots, with_compaction.in_memory_floor, version),
+    ensures
+        version_is_a_candidate(without_compaction.roots, without_compaction.in_memory_floor, version),
+        index_of_the_candidate_version(with_compaction.roots, with_compaction.in_memory_floor, version) == position[index_of_the_candidate_version(
+            without_compaction.roots,
+            without_compaction.in_memory_floor,
+            version,
+        )],
+        oldest_still_shown <= index_of_the_candidate_version(without_compaction.roots, without_compaction.in_memory_floor, version),
+{
+    let with_index = index_of_the_candidate_version(with_compaction.roots, with_compaction.in_memory_floor, version);
+    assert(with_compaction.roots[with_index].name is UserVersion);
+    let index = choose|index: int| 0 <= index < position.len() && #[trigger] position[index] == with_index;
+    assert(without_compaction.roots[index] == with_compaction.roots[with_index]);
+    assert(oldest_still_shown <= index);
+    assert(without_compaction.roots[index].name == (RootName::UserVersion { version }));
+    assert(version_is_a_candidate(without_compaction.roots, without_compaction.in_memory_floor, version));
+    let without_index = index_of_the_candidate_version(without_compaction.roots, without_compaction.in_memory_floor, version);
+    assert(without_compaction.roots[without_index].name == (RootName::UserVersion { version }));
+    if without_index < index {
+        assert(version_of_root(without_compaction.roots[without_index]) < version_of_root(without_compaction.roots[index]));
+    } else if index < without_index {
+        assert(version_of_root(without_compaction.roots[index]) < version_of_root(without_compaction.roots[without_index]));
+    }
+    assert(without_index == index);
+}
+
+// 整理那份接受了的点名，不整理那份也接受（有界穷举里的 b_accepts_a_rejects = 0）。
+pub proof fn lemma_compaction_never_admits_an_operation_the_plain_history_refuses(
+    without_compaction: RingObservation,
+    with_compaction: RingObservation,
+    compaction_publishes: nat,
+    operation: UserOperation,
+)
+    requires
+        compaction_keeps_what_the_user_sees(without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes),
+        user_operation_is_accepted(with_compaction, operation),
+    ensures
+        user_operation_is_accepted(without_compaction, operation),
+{
+    let (position, oldest_still_shown) = choose|position: Seq<int>, oldest_still_shown: int|
+        #[trigger] compaction_relation(without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown);
+    match operation {
+        UserOperation::Rollback { version } => {
+            lemma_a_version_named_in_the_compacted_history_is_the_corresponding_root(
+                without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown, version,
+            );
+        },
+        UserOperation::RaiseFloor { version } => {
+            lemma_a_version_named_in_the_compacted_history_is_the_corresponding_root(
+                without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown, version,
+            );
+        },
+        UserOperation::Publish { logical: _ } => {},
+        UserOperation::Checkpoint => {},
+    }
+}
+
+// 同一次发布落成根之后，整理那份的 oldest_still_shown：最旧的候选被挤出、而它正是 oldest_still_shown 那个根时加一，否则不变。
+pub open spec fn oldest_still_shown_after_a_publish(with_compaction: RingObservation, position: Seq<int>, oldest_still_shown: int) -> int {
+    if observed_floor_after_a_checkpoint(with_compaction) != with_compaction.in_memory_floor && oldest_still_shown < position.len()
+        && position[oldest_still_shown] == with_compaction.in_memory_floor {
+        oldest_still_shown + 1
+    } else {
+        oldest_still_shown
+    }
+}
+
+// 整理的发布（只在整理那份里）：k 加一，对应关系照旧，oldest_still_shown 照上面那一条走。
+pub proof fn lemma_a_compaction_publish_keeps_the_relation(
+    without_compaction: RingObservation,
+    with_compaction: RingObservation,
+    compaction_publishes: nat,
+    position: Seq<int>,
+    oldest_still_shown: int,
+)
+    requires
+        compaction_relation(without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown),
+    ensures
+        compaction_relation(
+            without_compaction,
+            observation_after_a_compaction_publish(with_compaction),
+            compaction_publishes + 1,
+            position,
+            oldest_still_shown_after_a_publish(with_compaction, position, oldest_still_shown),
+        ),
+{
+    lemma_the_compaction_relation_counts(without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown);
+    let after = observation_after_a_compaction_publish(with_compaction);
+    let oldest_still_shown_after = oldest_still_shown_after_a_publish(with_compaction, position, oldest_still_shown);
+    let with_floor = with_compaction.in_memory_floor;
+    assert forall|index: int| 0 <= index < position.len() implies 0 <= #[trigger] position[index] < after.roots.len()
+        && after.roots[position[index]] == without_compaction.roots[index] by {
+        assert(after.roots[position[index]] == with_compaction.roots[position[index]]);
+    }
+    assert forall|with_index: int|
+        0 <= with_index < after.roots.len() && (#[trigger] after.roots[with_index]).name is UserVersion implies exists|index: int|
+        0 <= index < position.len() && #[trigger] position[index] == with_index by {
+        if with_index < with_compaction.roots.len() {
+            assert(after.roots[with_index] == with_compaction.roots[with_index]);
+        } else {
+            assert(after.roots[with_index].name == RootName::CompactionPublish);
+        }
+    }
+    assert forall|index: int| 0 <= index < position.len() implies (after.in_memory_floor <= #[trigger] position[index] <==> oldest_still_shown_after
+        <= index) by {
+        if after.in_memory_floor != with_floor && oldest_still_shown < position.len() && position[oldest_still_shown] == with_floor {
+            if index > oldest_still_shown {
+                assert(position[oldest_still_shown] < position[index]);
+            } else if index < oldest_still_shown {
+                assert(position[index] < position[oldest_still_shown]);
+            }
+        } else if after.in_memory_floor != with_floor {
+            if index > oldest_still_shown {
+                assert(position[oldest_still_shown] < position[index]);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// 用户的一步、两份都接受：对应关系照旧（发布落成根时 position 多一项，oldest_still_shown 照 oldest_still_shown_after_a_publish 走；
+// 抬 F 时 oldest_still_shown 就是点到的那个根）。
+pub proof fn lemma_an_operation_accepted_by_both_keeps_the_relation(
+    without_compaction: RingObservation,
+    with_compaction: RingObservation,
+    compaction_publishes: nat,
+    position: Seq<int>,
+    oldest_still_shown: int,
+    operation: UserOperation,
+)
+    requires
+        compaction_relation(without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown),
+        user_operation_is_accepted(without_compaction, operation),
+        user_operation_is_accepted(with_compaction, operation),
+    ensures
+        compaction_keeps_what_the_user_sees(
+            observation_after_user_operation(without_compaction, operation),
+            observation_after_user_operation(with_compaction, operation),
+            compaction_publishes,
+        ),
+{
+    lemma_the_compaction_relation_counts(without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown);
+    let without_after = observation_after_user_operation(without_compaction, operation);
+    let with_after = observation_after_user_operation(with_compaction, operation);
+    match operation {
+        UserOperation::Publish { logical: _ } => {
+            assert(compaction_relation(without_after, with_after, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown));
+        },
+        UserOperation::Rollback { version } => {
+            lemma_a_version_named_in_the_compacted_history_is_the_corresponding_root(
+                without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown, version,
+            );
+            let without_index = index_of_the_candidate_version(
+                without_compaction.roots,
+                without_compaction.in_memory_floor,
+                version,
+            );
+            assert(with_compaction.roots[position[without_index]] == without_compaction.roots[without_index]);
+            assert(compaction_relation(without_after, with_after, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown));
+        },
+        UserOperation::RaiseFloor { version } => {
+            lemma_a_version_named_in_the_compacted_history_is_the_corresponding_root(
+                without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown, version,
+            );
+            let without_index = index_of_the_candidate_version(
+                without_compaction.roots,
+                without_compaction.in_memory_floor,
+                version,
+            );
+            let length = without_compaction.roots.len() as int;
+            lemma_strictly_increasing_positions_spread_out(position, without_index, length - 1);
+            assert(position[length - 1] < with_compaction.roots.len());
+            assert forall|index: int| 0 <= index < position.len() implies (with_after.in_memory_floor <= #[trigger] position[index]
+                <==> without_index <= index) by {
+                if index > without_index {
+                    assert(position[without_index] < position[index]);
+                } else if index < without_index {
+                    assert(position[index] < position[without_index]);
+                }
+            }
+            assert(compaction_relation(without_after, with_after, compaction_publishes, position, without_index));
+        },
+        UserOperation::Checkpoint => {
+            lemma_a_user_checkpoint_keeps_the_relation(
+                without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown,
+            );
+            assert(compaction_relation(
+                without_after,
+                with_after,
+                compaction_publishes,
+                position.push(with_compaction.roots.len() as int),
+                oldest_still_shown_after_a_publish(with_compaction, position, oldest_still_shown),
+            ));
+        },
+    }
+}
+
+
+// 用户的发布落成根（两份都做）：position 多一项指到整理那份的新根，oldest_still_shown 照 oldest_still_shown_after_a_publish 走。
+// 不整理那份挤掉最旧的候选时它的候选是满的，整理那份的候选不少于它、也满、也挤；oldest_still_shown 等于不整理那份的 F 时，
+// 整理那份最旧的候选就是 oldest_still_shown 那个根（lemma_the_compaction_relation_counts 的第三条）。
+pub proof fn lemma_a_user_checkpoint_keeps_the_relation(
+    without_compaction: RingObservation,
+    with_compaction: RingObservation,
+    compaction_publishes: nat,
+    position: Seq<int>,
+    oldest_still_shown: int,
+)
+    requires
+        compaction_relation(without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown),
+    ensures
+        compaction_relation(
+            observation_after_user_operation(without_compaction, UserOperation::Checkpoint),
+            observation_after_user_operation(with_compaction, UserOperation::Checkpoint),
+            compaction_publishes,
+            position.push(with_compaction.roots.len() as int),
+            oldest_still_shown_after_a_publish(with_compaction, position, oldest_still_shown),
+        ),
+{
+    lemma_the_compaction_relation_counts(without_compaction, with_compaction, compaction_publishes, position, oldest_still_shown);
+    let without_after = observation_after_user_operation(without_compaction, UserOperation::Checkpoint);
+    let with_after = observation_after_user_operation(with_compaction, UserOperation::Checkpoint);
+    let new_root = ObservedRoot {
+        logical: without_compaction.head_logical,
+        name: RootName::UserVersion { version: without_compaction.next_user_version },
+    };
+    let position_after = position.push(with_compaction.roots.len() as int);
+    let oldest_still_shown_after = oldest_still_shown_after_a_publish(with_compaction, position, oldest_still_shown);
+    let without_length = without_compaction.roots.len() as int;
+    let with_length = with_compaction.roots.len() as int;
+    let without_floor = without_compaction.in_memory_floor as int;
+    let with_floor = with_compaction.in_memory_floor as int;
+    assert(with_after.roots[with_length] == new_root);
+    assert(without_after.roots[without_length] == new_root);
+    assert forall|index: int| 0 <= index < without_after.roots.len() implies (#[trigger] without_after.roots[index]).name is UserVersion
+        && version_of_root(without_after.roots[index]) < without_after.next_user_version by {
+        if index < without_length {
+            assert(without_after.roots[index] == without_compaction.roots[index]);
+        }
+    }
+    assert forall|earlier: int, later: int|
+        #![trigger without_after.roots[earlier], without_after.roots[later]]
+        0 <= earlier < later < without_after.roots.len() implies version_of_root(without_after.roots[earlier])
+        < version_of_root(without_after.roots[later]) by {
+        assert(without_after.roots[earlier] == without_compaction.roots[earlier]);
+        if later < without_length {
+            assert(without_after.roots[later] == without_compaction.roots[later]);
+        }
+    }
+    assert forall|index: int| 0 <= index < position_after.len() implies 0 <= #[trigger] position_after[index]
+        < with_after.roots.len() && with_after.roots[position_after[index]] == without_after.roots[index] by {
+        if index < without_length {
+            assert(position_after[index] == position[index]);
+            assert(with_after.roots[position[index]] == with_compaction.roots[position[index]]);
+            assert(without_after.roots[index] == without_compaction.roots[index]);
+        }
+    }
+    assert forall|earlier: int, later: int|
+        #![trigger position_after[earlier], position_after[later]]
+        0 <= earlier < later < position_after.len() implies position_after[earlier] < position_after[later] by {
+        assert(position_after[earlier] == position[earlier]);
+        if later < without_length {
+            assert(position_after[later] == position[later]);
+        }
+    }
+    assert forall|with_index: int|
+        0 <= with_index < with_after.roots.len() && (#[trigger] with_after.roots[with_index]).name is UserVersion implies exists|index: int|
+        0 <= index < position_after.len() && #[trigger] position_after[index] == with_index by {
+        if with_index < with_length {
+            assert(with_after.roots[with_index] == with_compaction.roots[with_index]);
+            let index = choose|index: int| 0 <= index < position.len() && #[trigger] position[index] == with_index;
+            assert(position_after[index] == position[index]);
+        } else {
+            assert(position_after[without_length] == with_index);
+        }
+    }
+    assert forall|index: int| 0 <= index < position_after.len() implies (with_after.in_memory_floor
+        <= #[trigger] position_after[index] <==> oldest_still_shown_after <= index) by {
+        if index < without_length {
+            assert(position_after[index] == position[index]);
+            if with_after.in_memory_floor != with_floor && oldest_still_shown < position.len() && position[oldest_still_shown] == with_floor {
+                if index > oldest_still_shown {
+                    assert(position[oldest_still_shown] < position[index]);
+                } else if index < oldest_still_shown {
+                    assert(position[index] < position[oldest_still_shown]);
+                }
+            } else if with_after.in_memory_floor != with_floor {
+                if index > oldest_still_shown {
+                    assert(position[oldest_still_shown] < position[index]);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    if without_after.in_memory_floor != without_floor {
+        // 不整理那份挤掉了最旧的候选：它的候选是满的，整理那份也是满的、也挤；oldest_still_shown 等于不整理那份的 F 时
+        // 整理那份最旧的候选就是 oldest_still_shown 那个根。
+        assert(with_after.in_memory_floor != with_floor);
+        if oldest_still_shown == without_floor {
+            assert(position[oldest_still_shown] == with_floor);
+        }
+    }
+    assert(compaction_relation(without_after, with_after, compaction_publishes, position_after, oldest_still_shown_after));
+}
+
+// G7 的历史：一串事件，用户的一步两份都做，整理的发布只在整理那份里做。
+pub enum ObservedEvent {
+    User { operation: UserOperation },
+    CompactionPublish,
+}
+
+pub open spec fn observation_without_compaction(start: RingObservation, events: Seq<ObservedEvent>, count: int) -> RingObservation
+    decreases count,
+{
+    if count <= 0 {
+        start
+    } else {
+        let before = observation_without_compaction(start, events, count - 1);
+        match events[count - 1] {
+            ObservedEvent::User { operation } => observation_after_user_operation(before, operation),
+            ObservedEvent::CompactionPublish => before,
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+pub open spec fn observation_with_compaction(start: RingObservation, events: Seq<ObservedEvent>, count: int) -> RingObservation
+    decreases count,
+{
+    if count <= 0 {
+        start
+    } else {
+        let before = observation_with_compaction(start, events, count - 1);
+        match events[count - 1] {
+            ObservedEvent::User { operation } => observation_after_user_operation(before, operation),
+            ObservedEvent::CompactionPublish => observation_after_a_compaction_publish(before),
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// k：前 count 个事件里整理占的发布数。
+pub open spec fn compaction_publishes_among(events: Seq<ObservedEvent>, count: int) -> nat
+    decreases count,
+{
+    if count <= 0 {
+        0
+    } else {
+        match events[count - 1] {
+            ObservedEvent::User { operation: _ } => compaction_publishes_among(events, count - 1),
+            ObservedEvent::CompactionPublish => compaction_publishes_among(events, count - 1) + 1,
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+pub open spec fn event_is_accepted_by_both(start: RingObservation, events: Seq<ObservedEvent>, index: int) -> bool {
+    match events[index] {
+        ObservedEvent::User { operation } => user_operation_is_accepted(
+            observation_without_compaction(start, events, index),
+            operation,
+        ) && user_operation_is_accepted(observation_with_compaction(start, events, index), operation),
+        ObservedEvent::CompactionPublish => true,
+    }
+}
+
+// G7：从同一个起点出发（每个根都是用户发布的、版本号按次序），同一串用户历史两份都接受了每一步，整理那份另插 k 次整理的发布；
+// 前 count 个事件之后，现行内容相同，整理那份的回退候选（按版本号）是不整理那份候选的后缀、至多少 k 个，抬 F 的上限恰多 k。
+pub proof fn theorem_compaction_keeps_what_the_user_sees(start: RingObservation, events: Seq<ObservedEvent>, count: nat)
+    requires
+        observation_is_shaped(start),
+        every_root_is_a_user_version_in_order(start),
+        count <= events.len(),
+        forall|index: int| 0 <= index < events.len() ==> #[trigger] event_is_accepted_by_both(start, events, index),
+    ensures
+        compaction_keeps_what_the_user_sees(
+            observation_without_compaction(start, events, count as int),
+            observation_with_compaction(start, events, count as int),
+            compaction_publishes_among(events, count as int),
+        ),
+    decreases count,
+{
+    if count == 0 {
+        let identity = Seq::new(start.roots.len(), |index: int| index);
+        assert forall|with_index: int|
+            0 <= with_index < start.roots.len() && (#[trigger] start.roots[with_index]).name is UserVersion implies exists|index: int|
+            0 <= index < identity.len() && #[trigger] identity[index] == with_index by {
+            assert(identity[with_index] == with_index);
+        }
+        assert(compaction_relation(start, start, 0, identity, start.in_memory_floor as int));
+    } else {
+        let previous = (count - 1) as nat;
+        theorem_compaction_keeps_what_the_user_sees(start, events, previous);
+        let without_before = observation_without_compaction(start, events, previous as int);
+        let with_before = observation_with_compaction(start, events, previous as int);
+        let publishes_before = compaction_publishes_among(events, previous as int);
+        let (position, oldest_still_shown) = choose|position: Seq<int>, oldest_still_shown: int|
+            #[trigger] compaction_relation(without_before, with_before, publishes_before, position, oldest_still_shown);
+        assert(event_is_accepted_by_both(start, events, previous as int));
+        match events[previous as int] {
+            ObservedEvent::User { operation } => {
+                lemma_an_operation_accepted_by_both_keeps_the_relation(
+                    without_before, with_before, publishes_before, position, oldest_still_shown, operation,
+                );
+            },
+            ObservedEvent::CompactionPublish => {
+                lemma_a_compaction_publish_keeps_the_relation(
+                    without_before, with_before, publishes_before, position, oldest_still_shown,
+                );
+                assert(compaction_relation(
+                    without_before,
+                    observation_after_a_compaction_publish(with_before),
+                    publishes_before + 1,
+                    position,
+                    oldest_still_shown_after_a_publish(with_before, position, oldest_still_shown),
+                ));
+            },
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+} // verus!

+/// 攒批的会话（D16（发布语义） 已定项 2、5、10，判决 `research/prompts/m4-publish-trigger-r1-main-verification.md` 第二节；用户 2026-10-26 定射程
+/// 「串行下时间与脏量两种触发」）：一次可写挂载之后的会话（[`MountedSession`]）连同收下、还没发布的改动（待发）。数据写类改动经 [`Self::accept`]

+/// 只在 [`Self::accept`] 收下一个完整改动之后与调用方按周期调的 [`Self::publish_when_due`] 里判，一个请求不被触发切开；触发就把待发整个并成一次发布
+/// （[`UserChange::DataChangesPublishedTogether`]）。核心层不起线程、不读钟：`now` 是调用方交进来的单调读数，读数倒退当作没过时间、不回拨。
+///
+/// 屏障（unlink、截断、建删快照、整理、回退、卸载）进门先排空待发、自己单发：经 [`Self::accept`] 交进来的 unlink、截断、建删快照先排空、再照
+/// [`MountedSession::publish_user_change`] 单发；整理只在后台入口里跑（[`Self::run_compaction_in_the_background`]：判过起跑之后、跑之前先排空），
+/// [`Self::accept`] 与 [`Self::publish_when_due`] 发成之后只记「该跑了」，不在调用线程上跑整理（用户 2026-10-26 定「挪出调用线程」）；
+/// 回退与卸载要的是会话本身，只经 [`Self::into_session_after_publishing_the_pending_changes`] 交出——它先排空待发，所以类型上卸载、回退之前待发一定空了，
+/// 不会静默丢掉。原入口 [`MountedSession::publish_user_change`] 语义不变：这里的 [`Self::publish_user_change`] 先排空待发再交给它。
+///
+/// 待发与会话都是私有字段：只有这几个入口动得了它们，读只经 [`Self::session`] 与几个观测。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct MountedSessionWithPendingChanges {
+    session: MountedSession,
+    pending: PendingDataChanges,
+    thresholds: PublishTriggerThresholds,
+    /// 上一次发布那次调用交进来的读数（还没发布过时是第一次见到的读数，D16（发布语义） 已定项 5「上次 checkpoint 的时刻」）；一次读数都还没见过是 `None`。
+    /// 只往前走：读数倒退时不回拨。
+    reading_of_the_last_publish: Option<CallerMonotonicClockReading>,
+}
+
+/// 收下、还没发布的数据写类改动：折叠过的那一份整份写（同一 inode 的几次写只留最后一次）、按收下的次序的几次建 inode，
+/// 与收下的这几次改动各自单独发布要写的 journal 字节之和（D16（发布语义） 已定项 5：按待发改动要写的 journal 字节算，批内覆盖写 K 次按 K 次的记录照实算、不折叠）。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+struct PendingDataChanges {
+    whole_write: Option<PendingWholeWrite>,
+    new_inodes: Vec<NewInodesOfOneChange>,
+    journal_bytes_of_the_changes_accepted: JournalBytesToWrite,
+    changes_accepted: u64,
+}
+
+/// 待发里那一份整份写（内容自有）。
+#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
+struct PendingWholeWrite {
+    inode: InodeNumber,
+    content: Vec<u8>,
+    write_time_seconds: u64,
+}
+
+impl PendingDataChanges {
+    fn empty() -> Self {
+        Self {
+            whole_write: None,
+            new_inodes: Vec::new(),
+            journal_bytes_of_the_changes_accepted: JournalBytesToWrite::ZERO,
+            changes_accepted: 0,
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
+        self.changes_accepted == 0
+    }
+
+    /// 待发并成一次发布的样子。
+    fn as_published_together(&self) -> DataChangesPublishedTogether<'_> {
+        DataChangesPublishedTogether {
+            whole_write: self
+                .whole_write
+                .as_ref()
+                .map(|whole_write| WholeWriteOfOneInode {
+                    inode: whole_write.inode,
+                    content: &whole_write.content,
+                    write_time_seconds: whole_write.write_time_seconds,
+                }),
+            new_inodes: &self.new_inodes,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 这一批里建的 inode 一共几个（之后建的号从记账水位加上它起发）。
+    fn new_inodes_in_total(&self) -> u64 {
+        self.as_published_together().new_inodes_in_total()
+    }
+
+    /// 收下一次数据写类改动：整份写折叠（后到的盖掉先到的），建 inode 追加在后面；这次改动单独发布要写的 journal 字节加进合计。
+    fn take_in(
+        &mut self,
+        change: DataChangeAccepted<'_>,
+        journal_bytes_of_this_change: JournalBytesToWrite,
+    ) {
+        match change {
+            DataChangeAccepted::WholeWrite(whole_write) => {
+                self.whole_write = Some(PendingWholeWrite {
+                    inode: whole_write.inode,
+                    content: whole_write.content.to_vec(),
+                    write_time_seconds: whole_write.write_time_seconds,
+                });
+            }
+            DataChangeAccepted::NewInodes(new_inodes) => self.new_inodes.push(new_inodes),
+        }
+        self.journal_bytes_of_the_changes_accepted = self
+            .journal_bytes_of_the_changes_accepted
+            .plus(journal_bytes_of_this_change);
+        self.changes_accepted += 1;
+    }
+}
+
+/// 收得进待发的一次数据写类改动（D16（发布语义） 已定项 10「数据写类可并」）。封闭集合。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
+enum DataChangeAccepted<'content> {
+    WholeWrite(WholeWriteOfOneInode<'content>),
+    NewInodes(NewInodesOfOneChange),
+}
+
+impl<'content> DataChangeAccepted<'content> {
+    /// 这一次改动单独并成一批的样子（单独发布要写多少 journal 字节按它判）。`new_inodes` 是装建 inode 那一项的一格槽（借给返回值）。
+    fn alone(
+        self,
+        new_inodes: &'content mut [NewInodesOfOneChange; 1],
+    ) -> DataChangesPublishedTogether<'content> {
+        match self {
+            DataChangeAccepted::WholeWrite(whole_write) => DataChangesPublishedTogether {
+                whole_write: Some(whole_write),
+                new_inodes: &[],
+            },
+            DataChangeAccepted::NewInodes(created) => {
+                new_inodes[0] = created;
+                DataChangesPublishedTogether {
+                    whole_write: None,
+                    new_inodes: &new_inodes[..],
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// 交给 [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::accept`] 的一次改动按什么收。封闭集合。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
+enum ChangeAtTheAccept<'content> {
+    /// 数据写类：收进待发。覆盖写那两种（一个数据单元的契约）带 `fits_one_data_unit_only`。
+    Data {
+        change: DataChangeAccepted<'content>,
+        contract: WholeWriteContractAtTheAccept,
+    },
+    /// 屏障：先排空待发、再单发（unlink、截断、建删快照）。
+    Barrier,
+    /// 按偏移写：进不进待发、算哪一类条款没写（D16（发布语义） 已定项 10 只列了整份写、建 inode 与屏障），第一版不收。
+    WriteAtOffset,
+    /// 已经并好的一批：它是排空待发时交给会话的，不是用户的一次改动，收进待发条款没写，第一版不收。
+    DataChangesPublishedTogether,
+}
+
+/// 整份写的入口契约（同会话两条入口：覆盖写一个数据单元以内，顺序写不按单元数拒）。封闭集合。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+enum WholeWriteContractAtTheAccept {
+    OneDataUnit,
+    AnyNumberOfDataUnits,
+    /// 不是整份写（建 inode）。
+    NotAWholeWrite,
+}
+
+impl<'content> ChangeAtTheAccept<'content> {
+    fn of(change: UserChange<'content>) -> Self {
+        let whole_write = |inode: InodeNumber,
+                           content: &'content [u8],
+                           write_time_seconds: u64,
+                           contract: WholeWriteContractAtTheAccept| {
+            ChangeAtTheAccept::Data {
+                change: DataChangeAccepted::WholeWrite(WholeWriteOfOneInode {
+                    inode,
+                    content,
+                    write_time_seconds,
+                }),
+                contract,
+            }
+        };
+        let first_file = InodeNumber(crate::transaction::FIRST_INODE_NUMBER);
+        match change {
+            UserChange::Overwrite(file) => whole_write(
+                first_file,
+                file.content,
+                file.write_time_seconds,
+                WholeWriteContractAtTheAccept::OneDataUnit,
+            ),
+            UserChange::SequentialWrite(file) => whole_write(
+                first_file,
+                file.content,
+                file.write_time_seconds,
+                WholeWriteContractAtTheAccept::AnyNumberOfDataUnits,
+            ),
+            UserChange::OverwriteOfAnInode {
+                inode,
+                content,
+                write_time_seconds,
+            } => whole_write(
+                inode,
+                content,
+                write_time_seconds,
+                WholeWriteContractAtTheAccept::OneDataUnit,
+            ),
+            UserChange::SequentialWriteOfAnInode {
+                inode,
+                content,
+                write_time_seconds,
+            } => whole_write(
+                inode,
+                content,
+                write_time_seconds,
+                WholeWriteContractAtTheAccept::AnyNumberOfDataUnits,
+            ),
+            UserChange::NewInodes {
+                count,
+                write_time_seconds,
+            } => ChangeAtTheAccept::Data {
+                change: DataChangeAccepted::NewInodes(NewInodesOfOneChange {
+                    count,
+                    write_time_seconds,
+                }),
+                contract: WholeWriteContractAtTheAccept::NotAWholeWrite,
+            },
+            UserChange::Unlink { .. }
+            | UserChange::Truncate { .. }
+            | UserChange::CreateSnapshot
+            | UserChange::DestroySnapshot { .. } => ChangeAtTheAccept::Barrier,
+            UserChange::WriteAtOffset { .. } => ChangeAtTheAccept::WriteAtOffset,
+            UserChange::DataChangesPublishedTogether(_) => {
+                ChangeAtTheAccept::DataChangesPublishedTogether
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// 一次触发是哪一支先到（`.claude/rules/fs-design.md` 五条硬要求第 4 条：分支可观测）。封闭集合。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum PublishTriggerCause {
+    /// now − 上次发布的读数 ≥ `T_time`，脏量还没到。
+    TimeThreshold,
+    /// 待发改动要写的 journal 字节 ≥ 有效 `T_dirty`，时间还没到。
+    DirtyThreshold,
+    /// 两支同时到。
+    BothThresholds,
+}
+
+/// D16（发布语义） 已定项 2 的触发式：待发非空 ∧（离上次发布过了 `T_time` ∨ 待发改动要写的 journal 字节到了有效 `T_dirty`）。待发空时两支都不看
+/// （空闲时不推空发布：照不带这一合取的式子，空闲时每 `T_time` 一次空发布，把回退候选集挤掉——判决第二节「时间那一支」那一格）。
+/// `time_since_the_last_publish` 是调用方按读数算好的间隔（读数倒退时是 0：当作没过时间）。纯函数。
+#[must_use]
+pub fn publish_trigger_cause(
+    pending_is_empty: bool,
+    time_since_the_last_publish: Duration,
+    journal_bytes_of_the_pending_changes: JournalBytesToWrite,
+    thresholds: PublishTriggerThresholds,
+) -> Option<PublishTriggerCause> {
+    if pending_is_empty {
+        return None;
+    }
+    let is_time_reached = time_since_the_last_publish >= thresholds.time_threshold();
+    let is_dirty_reached = journal_bytes_of_the_pending_changes >= thresholds.dirty_threshold();
+    match (is_time_reached, is_dirty_reached) {
+        (true, true) => Some(PublishTriggerCause::BothThresholds),
+        (true, false) => Some(PublishTriggerCause::TimeThreshold),
+        (false, true) => Some(PublishTriggerCause::DirtyThreshold),
+        (false, false) => None,
+    }
+}
+
+/// 攒批的会话这一次为什么发布（报给调用方，RefFS 翻译按它把每一次发布翻成一个显式发布点，判决第二节「RefFS」那一格）。封闭集合。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum ReasonOfThePublish {
+    /// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::accept`] 收下这次改动之后触发，待发整个并成一次发布（这次改动在里面）。
+    TriggeredAfterTheAccept(PublishTriggerCause),
+    /// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::publish_when_due`] 里触发。
+    TriggeredWhenDue(PublishTriggerCause),
+    /// 屏障进门之前排空待发（屏障自己不在里面）。
+    PendingChangesPublishedBeforeABarrier,
+    /// 屏障自己那一次（[`MountedSession::publish_user_change`] 单发：unlink、截断连同它们的全部批）。
+    BarrierPublishedAlone,
+    /// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::publish_pending_now`]：立即排空。
+    PendingChangesPublishedOnRequest,
+    /// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::publish_user_change`] 之前排空待发。
+    PendingChangesPublishedBeforeTheUserChange,
+    /// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::publish_user_change`] 那一次改动自己。
+    UserChangePublishedAlone,
+    /// 后台整理判过起跑、跑之前排空待发。
+    PendingChangesPublishedBeforeTheBackgroundCompaction,
+    /// 交出会话（卸载、回退之前）排空待发。
+    PendingChangesPublishedBeforeHandingBackTheSession,
+}
+
+/// 攒批的会话报的一次发布：为什么发、发成了什么（推的抬 F、发成的每一版、之后发的 discard，同 [`UserChangePublished`]）。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct PublishReportedByTheSession {
+    pub reason: ReasonOfThePublish,
+    pub published: UserChangePublished,
+}
+
+/// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::accept`] 收下了：怎么收的、这次调用里报的每一次发布（按先后）。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct ChangeAccepted {
+    pub taken: HowTheChangeWasTaken,
+    pub publishes: Vec<PublishReportedByTheSession>,
+}
+
+/// 一次改动在 [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::accept`] 里怎么收的。封闭集合。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum HowTheChangeWasTaken {
+    /// 收进待发；`journal_bytes_of_this_change` 是这次改动单独发布要写的 journal 字节（加进待发的合计）。收下之后触发了，待发连同它已经发成
+    /// （报在 [`ChangeAccepted::publishes`] 里）。
+    KeptPending {
+        journal_bytes_of_this_change: JournalBytesToWrite,
+    },
+    /// 屏障：先排空待发、再单发，都已发成。
+    PublishedAloneAsABarrier,
+}
+
+/// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::accept`] 没收下，或收下之后触发的那一次发布没发成。成员按调用方要做的决定分。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub enum AcceptRefused {
+    /// 分配器上冻结着一次写失败、没重发的发布（D23（journal 的角色与格式） 已定项 14；判决第二节「串行下不立的」那一格「冻结时 `accept` 拒」）：
+    /// 在任何读写之前拒，待发不动、不长。调用方要做的是先原样重发那一次（交出会话，`transaction::resend_the_frozen_publish`）。
+    PublishFrozenAfterAWriteFailureIsNotResentYet {
+        checkpoint_txg: CheckpointTxg,
+        instance: InstanceGeneration,
+    },
+    /// 同 [`UserChangeRefused::DeviceTableOtherThanTheOneOfTheMount`]，在任何读写之前。
+    DeviceTableOtherThanTheOneOfTheMount {
+        device_table_of_the_mount: Vec<DeviceIdentity>,
+        device_table_handed_in: Vec<DeviceIdentity>,
+    },
+    /// 现行那一版没有可改的文件（树表 0 条；或有树而文件集合为空而这次是整份写），同 [`UserChangeRefused::NoFileVersionToChange`]，在任何读写之前。
+    NoFileVersionToChange,
+    /// 现行那一版的承诺类意图队列（`deleted_inodes`、销毁中的快照、截断条目）没走空：会话里每一次用户改动先走空（D8（核心索引结构） 已定项 16 第 6 条），
+    /// 走空是写，而这次的预判要在任何读写之前做、要接在走空之后的那一版上判——两样合不到一起，条款没写，第一版不支持。在任何读写之前拒；
+    /// 调用方要做的是先经 [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::publish_user_change`] 发一次（它先走空）。
+    QueueOfCommittedIntentsNotWalkedBeforeTheAcceptNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion,
+    /// 按偏移写进不进待发、算数据写类还是屏障，条款没写（D16（发布语义） 已定项 10 只列整份写、建 inode 与屏障），第一版不支持。在任何读写之前拒；
+    /// 调用方要做的是经 [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::publish_user_change`] 单发它。
+    WriteAtOffsetIntoThePendingChangesNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion,
+    /// 交进来的是已经并好的一批（[`UserChange::DataChangesPublishedTogether`]）：把一批再收进待发条款没写，第一版不支持。在任何读写之前拒。
+    DataChangesPublishedTogetherIntoThePendingChangesNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion,
+    /// 待发里已经有另一个文件的整份写：一次发布写一个文件以内是这一版发布计划的形状（`transaction::PublishPlan::file`），不同 inode 的写并不并进一次发布
+    /// 条款没写（D16（发布语义） 已定项 10「同一 inode 的写折叠」管不到两个号），第一版不支持。在任何读写之前拒；调用方要做的是先
+    /// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::publish_pending_now`]、再交这次的写。
+    WriteToASecondInodeInOneBatchNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion {
+        inode_pending: InodeNumber,
+        inode_written: InodeNumber,
+    },
+    /// 写的号是待发里建 inode 那几次要发的号（还不在现行那一版的树里）：同一次发布里建一个 inode 又写它，条款没写，第一版不支持。在任何读写之前拒。
+    WriteToAnInodeCreatedByThePendingChangesNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion { inode: InodeNumber },
+    /// 这一次改动单独发布就过不了落盘之前那几判（`transaction::journal_bytes_of_data_changes_published_together_judged_before_any_read_or_write`：
+    /// 号不在树里、删除中、内容装不进覆盖写的一个数据单元、准入、落点、记录条数……），`cause` 原样。在任何读写之前拒，待发不动。
+    ChangeRefusedByThePublishJudgement(Box<PublishError>),
+    /// 这一次改动单独过得了，并进待发合起来这一批过不了（判决第二节「一次发布里攒什么」那一格：`accept` 进门先做这一批合起来的准入与条数预判，
+    /// 过不了就在任何读写之前拒，不在返回成功之后拒），`cause` 原样。在任何读写之前拒，待发不动；调用方要做的是先排空待发、再交这一次。
+    PendingChangesTogetherWithThisChangeRefusedByThePublishJudgement(Box<PublishError>),
+    /// 屏障进门之前排空待发没发成（`refusal` 原样；推的抬 F、发成的走空步在里面）：屏障没发。
+    PublishOfThePendingChangesBeforeTheBarrierRefused(Box<UserChangeRefused>),
+    /// 待发已排空（`publishes_before_the_refusal`），屏障自己没发成（`refusal` 原样）。
+    BarrierRefused {
+        publishes_before_the_refusal: Vec<PublishReportedByTheSession>,
+        refusal: Box<UserChangeRefused>,
+    },
+    /// 这次改动已收进待发，收下之后触发的那一次发布没发成（`refusal` 原样）：没冻结时待发原样留着（连同这一次），下一次触发再发；
+    /// 冻结了时待发并进了冻结的那一次（D16（发布语义） 已定项 17：报错之后这次发布可能已成也可能未成），待发清空。
+    AcceptedButTheTriggeredPublishRefused(Box<UserChangeRefused>),
+}
+
+/// 排空待发那一次没发成（[`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::publish_when_due`]、[`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::publish_pending_now`]）：
+/// `refusal` 原样。没冻结时待发原样留着；冻结了时待发并进了冻结的那一次、清空（D16（发布语义） 已定项 17）。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct PublishOfThePendingChangesRefused {
+    pub refusal: Box<UserChangeRefused>,
+}
+
+/// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::publish_user_change`] 没发成：之前排空的那一次（发成了就在 `publishes_before_the_refusal` 里）与这一次的拒绝。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct UserChangeAfterThePendingChangesRefused {
+    pub publishes_before_the_refusal: Vec<PublishReportedByTheSession>,
+    pub refusal: Box<UserChangeRefused>,
+}
+
+/// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::run_compaction_in_the_background`] 做成了什么：判过起跑之后先排空的那一次（待发空、没起跑时 `None`）与后台入口这一次。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct BackgroundCompactionAfterThePendingChanges {
+    pub pending_changes_published_before_the_run: Option<PublishReportedByTheSession>,
+    pub call: BackgroundCompactionCall,
+}
+
+/// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::run_compaction_in_the_background`] 没跑。成员按调用方要做的决定分。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub enum BackgroundCompactionAfterThePendingChangesRefused {
+    /// 后台入口自己在任何读写之前拒（同 [`MountedSession::run_compaction_in_the_background`]）。
+    CompactionRefused(CompactionRunRefused),
+    /// 判过起跑、跑之前排空待发没发成：这一趟整理没跑，用户改动之后记下的「该跑了」放回去。
+    PublishOfThePendingChangesRefused(Box<UserChangeRefused>),
+}
+
+/// [`MountedSessionWithPendingChanges::into_session_after_publishing_the_pending_changes`] 交不出会话：排空待发没发成，攒批的会话原样交回。
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct HandingBackTheSessionRefused {
+    pub session_with_pending_changes: MountedSessionWithPendingChanges,
+    pub refusal: Box<UserChangeRefused>,
+}
+
+impl MountedSessionWithPendingChanges {
+    /// 会话接上待发（一开始空的），两个阈值取这次挂载的有效值（[`PublishTriggerThresholds::of_the_mount`]：`T_time` 5000 ms，
+    /// `T_dirty` = min(2 GiB, 环长 ÷ F)）。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn of_the_session(session: MountedSession) -> Self {
+        let thresholds = PublishTriggerThresholds::of_the_mount(
+            session
+                .parameters_and_device_table
+                .parameters_on_disk()
+                .geometry
+                .journal_ring_bytes,
+        );
+        Self::of_the_session_with_thresholds(session, thresholds)
+    }
+
+    /// 同 [`Self::of_the_session`]，两个阈值由调用方给：产品路径上只拿得到 [`PublishTriggerThresholds::of_the_mount`] 那一份，只供测试的那一份
+    /// 在默认关的特性后面（[`PublishTriggerThresholds`] 文档）。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn of_the_session_with_thresholds(
+        session: MountedSession,
+        thresholds: PublishTriggerThresholds,
+    ) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            session,
+            pending: PendingDataChanges::empty(),
+            thresholds,
+            reading_of_the_last_publish: None,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 底下那个会话（只读）。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn session(&self) -> &MountedSession {
+        &self.session
+    }
+
+    /// 这次挂载生效的两个阈值。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn thresholds(&self) -> PublishTriggerThresholds {
+        self.thresholds
+    }
+
+    /// 待发里收下了几次改动（排空之后归零）。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn pending_changes_accepted(&self) -> u64 {
+        self.pending.changes_accepted
+    }
+
+    /// 待发里那几次改动各自单独发布要写的 journal 字节之和（脏量那一支比的量）。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn journal_bytes_of_the_pending_changes(&self) -> JournalBytesToWrite {
+        self.pending.journal_bytes_of_the_changes_accepted
+    }
+
+    /// 上一次发布那次调用交进来的读数（还没发布过时是第一次见到的读数）。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn reading_of_the_last_publish(&self) -> Option<CallerMonotonicClockReading> {
+        self.reading_of_the_last_publish
+    }
+
+    /// 第一次见到的读数当基线（还没发布过时「上次发布的时刻」取它）。
+    fn note_the_reading_seen(&mut self, now: CallerMonotonicClockReading) {
+        if self.reading_of_the_last_publish.is_none() {
+            self.reading_of_the_last_publish = Some(now);
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 发成一次：上次发布的读数取这次调用交进来的那一个，只往前走（读数倒退时不回拨）。
+    fn note_a_publish(&mut self, now: CallerMonotonicClockReading) {
+        self.reading_of_the_last_publish = Some(match self.reading_of_the_last_publish {
+            Some(before) => before.max(now),
+            None => now,
+        });
+    }
+
+    /// 此刻（`now`）触不触发：读数倒退时间隔是 0（当作没过时间）。
+    fn trigger_cause_at(&self, now: CallerMonotonicClockReading) -> Option<PublishTriggerCause> {
+        let time_since_the_last_publish = match self.reading_of_the_last_publish {
+            Some(last) => now.0.saturating_sub(last.0),
+            None => Duration::ZERO,
+        };
+        publish_trigger_cause(
+            self.pending.is_empty(),
+            time_since_the_last_publish,
+            self.pending.journal_bytes_of_the_changes_accepted,
+            self.thresholds,
+        )
+    }
+
+    /// 把待发整个并成一次发布交给会话（[`UserChange::DataChangesPublishedTogether`]，先走空队列、被空间拒照旧推抬 F 再判）。待发空就什么都不发、交回 `None`
+    /// （不推空发布）。发成：待发清空、记下这次的读数。没发成：没冻结时待发原样放回；冻结了时待发并进了冻结的那一次，不放回（D16（发布语义） 已定项 17）。
+    fn publish_the_pending_changes<Device: BlockDevice>(
+        &mut self,
+        devices: &mut Vec<(DeviceIdentity, Device)>,
+        now: CallerMonotonicClockReading,
+        reason: ReasonOfThePublish,
+    ) -> Result<Option<PublishReportedByTheSession>, Box<UserChangeRefused>> {
+        if self.pending.is_empty() {
+            return Ok(None);
+        }
+        let pending = std::mem::replace(&mut self.pending, PendingDataChanges::empty());
+        match self.session.publish_user_change(
+            devices,
+            UserChange::DataChangesPublishedTogether(pending.as_published_together()),
+        ) {
+            Ok(published) => {
+                self.note_a_publish(now);
+                Ok(Some(PublishReportedByTheSession { reason, published }))
+            }
+            Err(refusal) => {
+                if self.session.allocator.frozen_publish().is_none() {
+                    self.pending = pending;
+                }
+                Err(Box::new(refusal))
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 收下一次用户改动（D16（发布语义） 已定项 10，判决第二节「一次发布里攒什么」「串行下不立的」两格）：
+    /// 1. 冻结着一次没重发的发布、交进来的盘表与挂载核过的不同：在任何读写之前拒。
+    /// 2. 屏障（unlink、截断、建删快照）：先排空待发（一次发布）、再照 [`MountedSession::publish_user_change`] 单发，两次都报。
+    /// 3. 数据写类（整份写、建 inode）：在任何读写之前先判——现行那一版有可改的文件、队列走空了、并得进待发（至多一个文件、不写待发里建的号）、
+    ///    这一次单独发布过得了落盘之前那几判、并进待发合起来的这一批也过得了（准入与条数预判，`transaction::journal_bytes_of_data_changes_published_together_judged_before_any_read_or_write`）；
+    ///    有一样不过就拒，一个盘都不读、一个写都不发、待发不动。都过了才收进待发（同一 inode 的写折叠、建 inode 追加），脏量加上这一次单独发布要写的 journal 字节；
+    ///    收下之后判一次触发（[`publish_trigger_cause`]），触发就把待发整个并成一次发布。
+    /// 4. 按偏移写、已经并好的一批：条款没写，在任何读写之前拒。
+    ///
+    /// 整理不在这里跑：发成之后起跑判据为真只记「该跑了」（[`MountedSession::publish_user_change`]），由后台入口去跑。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// [`AcceptRefused`] 的几种。
+    pub fn accept<Device: BlockDevice>(
+        &mut self,
+        devices: &mut Vec<(DeviceIdentity, Device)>,
+        change: UserChange<'_>,
+        now: CallerMonotonicClockReading,
+    ) -> Result<ChangeAccepted, AcceptRefused> {
+        self.note_the_reading_seen(now);
+        if let Some(frozen) = self.session.allocator.frozen_publish() {
+            return Err(
+                AcceptRefused::PublishFrozenAfterAWriteFailureIsNotResentYet {
+                    checkpoint_txg: frozen.checkpoint_txg(),
+                    instance: frozen.instance(),
+                },
+            );
+        }
+        if !self
+            .session
+            .parameters_and_device_table
+            .is_the_device_table_of_the_mount(devices)
+        {
+            return Err(AcceptRefused::DeviceTableOtherThanTheOneOfTheMount {
+                device_table_of_the_mount: self
+                    .session
+                    .parameters_and_device_table
+                    .device_identities_in_table_order()
+                    .to_vec(),
+                device_table_handed_in: devices.iter().map(|(identity, _)| *identity).collect(),
+            });
+        }
+        let (data_change, contract) = match ChangeAtTheAccept::of(change) {
+            ChangeAtTheAccept::Barrier => return self.publish_a_barrier_alone(devices, change, now),
+            ChangeAtTheAccept::WriteAtOffset => {
+                return Err(
+                    AcceptRefused::WriteAtOffsetIntoThePendingChangesNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion,
+                )
+            }
+            ChangeAtTheAccept::DataChangesPublishedTogether => {
+                return Err(AcceptRefused::DataChangesPublishedTogetherIntoThePendingChangesNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion)
+            }
+            ChangeAtTheAccept::Data { change, contract } => (change, contract),
+        };
+        let journal_bytes_of_this_change =
+            self.judge_a_data_change_before_any_read_or_write(devices, data_change, contract)?;
+        self.pending
+            .take_in(data_change, journal_bytes_of_this_change);
+        let mut publishes = Vec::new();
+        if let Some(cause) = self.trigger_cause_at(now) {
+            if let Some(published) = self
+                .publish_the_pending_changes(
+                    devices,
+                    now,
+                    ReasonOfThePublish::TriggeredAfterTheAccept(cause),
+                )
+                .map_err(AcceptRefused::AcceptedButTheTriggeredPublishRefused)?
+            {
+                publishes.push(published);
+            }
+        }
+        Ok(ChangeAccepted {
+            taken: HowTheChangeWasTaken::KeptPending {
+                journal_bytes_of_this_change,
+            },
+            publishes,
+        })
+    }
+
+    /// [`Self::accept`] 收数据写类改动之前那几判，在任何读写之前：交回这一次单独发布要写的 journal 字节。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// [`AcceptRefused::NoFileVersionToChange`]、`QueueOfCommittedIntentsNotWalkedBeforeTheAcceptNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion`、
+    /// `WriteToASecondInodeInOneBatchNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion`、`WriteToAnInodeCreatedByThePendingChangesNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion`、
+    /// `ChangeRefusedByThePublishJudgement`、`PendingChangesTogetherWithThisChangeRefusedByThePublishJudgement`。
+    fn judge_a_data_change_before_any_read_or_write<Device: BlockDevice>(
+        &self,
+        devices: &mut Vec<(DeviceIdentity, Device)>,
+        data_change: DataChangeAccepted<'_>,
+        contract: WholeWriteContractAtTheAccept,
+    ) -> Result<JournalBytesToWrite, AcceptRefused> {
+        let current_version = match (&self.session.current, data_change) {
+            (PoolVersion::WithFile(version), _)
+            | (PoolVersion::WithTreesAndNoFile(version), DataChangeAccepted::NewInodes(_)) => {
+                version
+            }
+            (PoolVersion::WithTreesAndNoFile(_), DataChangeAccepted::WholeWrite(_))
+            | (PoolVersion::WithoutFile(_), _) => return Err(AcceptRefused::NoFileVersionToChange),
+        };
+        if !current_version.queue_of_committed_intents_is_empty() {
+            return Err(AcceptRefused::QueueOfCommittedIntentsNotWalkedBeforeTheAcceptNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion);
+        }
+        if let DataChangeAccepted::WholeWrite(whole_write) = data_change {
+            if let Some(pending_whole_write) = &self.pending.whole_write {
+                if pending_whole_write.inode != whole_write.inode {
+                    return Err(
+                        AcceptRefused::WriteToASecondInodeInOneBatchNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion {
+                            inode_pending: pending_whole_write.inode,
+                            inode_written: whole_write.inode,
+                        },
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+            let first_number_created_by_the_pending_changes =
+                current_version.inode_number_watermark();
+            let is_created_by_the_pending_changes = whole_write.inode.0
+                >= first_number_created_by_the_pending_changes
+                && whole_write.inode.0 - first_number_created_by_the_pending_changes
+                    < self.pending.new_inodes_in_total();
+            if is_created_by_the_pending_changes {
+                return Err(
+                    AcceptRefused::WriteToAnInodeCreatedByThePendingChangesNotSupportedInTheFirstVersion {
+                        inode: whole_write.inode,
+                    },
+                );
+            }
+            if contract == WholeWriteContractAtTheAccept::OneDataUnit
+                && whole_write.content.len() > data_unit_payload_capacity()
+            {
+                return Err(AcceptRefused::ChangeRefusedByThePublishJudgement(Box::new(
+                    PublishError::ContentExceedsDataUnit {
+                        bytes: whole_write.content.len(),
+                        capacity: data_unit_payload_capacity(),
+                    },
+                )));
+            }
+        }
+        let parameters = self
+            .session
+            .parameters_and_device_table
+            .parameters_on_disk();
+        let mut writer = PoolWriter::new(parameters, devices.as_mut_slice());
+        writer.set_container_tree_capacities(
+            self.session
+                .allocator
+                .deletion_switches()
+                .container_tree_capacities(),
+        );
+        let mut slot_of_the_new_inodes = [NewInodesOfOneChange {
+            count: 0,
+            write_time_seconds: 0,
+        }];
+        let journal_bytes_of_this_change =
+            journal_bytes_of_data_changes_published_together_judged_before_any_read_or_write(
+                &writer,
+                &self.session.allocator,
+                current_version,
+                data_change.alone(&mut slot_of_the_new_inodes),
+                self.session.instance,
+            )
+            .map_err(|cause| AcceptRefused::ChangeRefusedByThePublishJudgement(Box::new(cause)))?;
+        let mut new_inodes_together = self.pending.new_inodes.clone();
+        let whole_write_together = match data_change {
+            DataChangeAccepted::WholeWrite(whole_write) => Some(whole_write),
+            DataChangeAccepted::NewInodes(created) => {
+                new_inodes_together.push(created);
+                self.pending
+                    .whole_write
+                    .as_ref()
+                    .map(|pending_whole_write| WholeWriteOfOneInode {
+                        inode: pending_whole_write.inode,
+                        content: &pending_whole_write.content,
+                        write_time_seconds: pending_whole_write.write_time_seconds,
+                    })
+            }
+        };
+        journal_bytes_of_data_changes_published_together_judged_before_any_read_or_write(
+            &writer,
+            &self.session.allocator,
+            current_version,
+            DataChangesPublishedTogether {
+                whole_write: whole_write_together,
+                new_inodes: &new_inodes_together,
+            },
+            self.session.instance,
+        )
+        .map_err(|cause| {
+            AcceptRefused::PendingChangesTogetherWithThisChangeRefusedByThePublishJudgement(
+                Box::new(cause),
+            )
+        })?;
+        Ok(journal_bytes_of_this_change)
+    }
+
+    /// 屏障进门：先排空待发、再单发。
+    fn publish_a_barrier_alone<Device: BlockDevice>(
+        &mut self,
+        devices: &mut Vec<(DeviceIdentity, Device)>,
+        change: UserChange<'_>,
+        now: CallerMonotonicClockReading,
+    ) -> Result<ChangeAccepted, AcceptRefused> {
+        let mut publishes = Vec::new();
+        if let Some(drained) = self
+            .publish_the_pending_changes(
+                devices,
+                now,
+                ReasonOfThePublish::PendingChangesPublishedBeforeABarrier,
+            )
+            .map_err(AcceptRefused::PublishOfThePendingChangesBeforeTheBarrierRefused)?
+        {
+            publishes.push(drained);
+        }
+        match self.session.publish_user_change(devices, change) {
+            Ok(published) => {
+                self.note_a_publish(now);
+                publishes.push(PublishReportedByTheSession {
+                    reason: ReasonOfThePublish::BarrierPublishedAlone,
+                    published,
+                });
+                Ok(ChangeAccepted {
+                    taken: HowTheChangeWasTaken::PublishedAloneAsABarrier,
+                    publishes,
+                })
+            }
+            Err(refusal) => Err(AcceptRefused::BarrierRefused {
+                publishes_before_the_refusal: publishes,
+                refusal: Box::new(refusal),
+            }),
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 调用方按周期调（D16（发布语义） 已定项 2、5：丢失窗口里的 P 是这个周期，归调用方）：判一次触发，触发就把待发整个并成一次发布。
+    /// 待发空、或两支都没到，就什么都不发、交回 `None`，一个盘都不读。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// 触发的那一次没发成：[`PublishOfThePendingChangesRefused`]。
+    pub fn publish_when_due<Device: BlockDevice>(
+        &mut self,
+        devices: &mut Vec<(DeviceIdentity, Device)>,
+        now: CallerMonotonicClockReading,
+    ) -> Result<Option<PublishReportedByTheSession>, PublishOfThePendingChangesRefused> {
+        self.note_the_reading_seen(now);
+        let Some(cause) = self.trigger_cause_at(now) else {
+            return Ok(None);
+        };
+        self.publish_the_pending_changes(devices, now, ReasonOfThePublish::TriggeredWhenDue(cause))
+            .map_err(|refusal| PublishOfThePendingChangesRefused { refusal })
+    }
+
+    /// 立即排空（D16（发布语义） 已定项 11：只是提前触发一次发布，同一个 journal、同一条发布路径）：待发非空就整个并成一次发布；待发空就什么都不发、交回 `None`
+    /// （不推空发布）。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// 同 [`Self::publish_when_due`]。
+    pub fn publish_pending_now<Device: BlockDevice>(
+        &mut self,
+        devices: &mut Vec<(DeviceIdentity, Device)>,
+        now: CallerMonotonicClockReading,
+    ) -> Result<Option<PublishReportedByTheSession>, PublishOfThePendingChangesRefused> {
+        self.note_the_reading_seen(now);
+        self.publish_the_pending_changes(
+            devices,
+            now,
+            ReasonOfThePublish::PendingChangesPublishedOnRequest,
+        )
+        .map_err(|refusal| PublishOfThePendingChangesRefused { refusal })
+    }
+
+    /// 原入口（[`MountedSession::publish_user_change`]）语义不变，只多一条先排空待发：待发非空就先并成一次发布，再交这一次改动（任何一种）单发。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// 排空或这一次没发成：[`UserChangeAfterThePendingChangesRefused`]（排空发成了的那一次在里面）。
+    pub fn publish_user_change<Device: BlockDevice>(
+        &mut self,
+        devices: &mut Vec<(DeviceIdentity, Device)>,
+        change: UserChange<'_>,
+        now: CallerMonotonicClockReading,
+    ) -> Result<Vec<PublishReportedByTheSession>, UserChangeAfterThePendingChangesRefused> {
+        self.note_the_reading_seen(now);
+        let mut publishes = Vec::new();
+        match self.publish_the_pending_changes(
+            devices,
+            now,
+            ReasonOfThePublish::PendingChangesPublishedBeforeTheUserChange,
+        ) {
+            Ok(Some(drained)) => publishes.push(drained),
+            Ok(None) => {}
+            Err(refusal) => {
+                return Err(UserChangeAfterThePendingChangesRefused {
+                    publishes_before_the_refusal: publishes,
+                    refusal,
+                })
+            }
+        }
+        match self.session.publish_user_change(devices, change) {
+            Ok(published) => {
+                self.note_a_publish(now);
+                publishes.push(PublishReportedByTheSession {
+                    reason: ReasonOfThePublish::UserChangePublishedAlone,
+                    published,
+                });
+                Ok(publishes)
+            }
+            Err(refusal) => Err(UserChangeAfterThePendingChangesRefused {
+                publishes_before_the_refusal: publishes,
+                refusal: Box::new(refusal),
+            }),
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 整理的后台入口（[`MountedSession::run_compaction_in_the_background`]）连同待发：整理是屏障——待发里不并进整理的发布，判过起跑之后、
+    /// 那一趟起跑之前先把待发排空（判决第二节「一次发布里攒什么」那一格；整理仍只在后台入口里跑）。没起跑就不排空。
+    /// 排空那一次是一次用户改动的发布：`B_gc` 从它重新数、起跑判据为真记「该跑了」（同 [`MountedSession::publish_user_change`]）。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// [`BackgroundCompactionAfterThePendingChangesRefused`] 的两种。
+    pub fn run_compaction_in_the_background<Device: BlockDevice>(
+        &mut self,
+        devices: &mut Vec<(DeviceIdentity, Device)>,
+        pacing: CompactionPacing,
+        caller: &dyn CallerOfTheBackgroundCompaction,
+    ) -> Result<
+        BackgroundCompactionAfterThePendingChanges,
+        BackgroundCompactionAfterThePendingChangesRefused,
+    > {
+        let now = caller.clock_reading();
+        self.note_the_reading_seen(now);
+        let (trigger, reach, budget) = match self
+            .session
+            .whether_the_background_compaction_starts(devices, pacing, caller)
+            .map_err(BackgroundCompactionAfterThePendingChangesRefused::CompactionRefused)?
+        {
+            BackgroundCompactionStart::NotStarted(not_started) => {
+                return Ok(BackgroundCompactionAfterThePendingChanges {
+                    pending_changes_published_before_the_run: None,
+                    call: BackgroundCompactionCall::NotStarted(not_started),
+                })
+            }
+            BackgroundCompactionStart::Starts {
+                trigger,
+                reach,
+                budget,
+            } => (trigger, reach, budget),
+        };
+        let pending_changes_published_before_the_run = match self.publish_the_pending_changes(
+            devices,
+            now,
+            ReasonOfThePublish::PendingChangesPublishedBeforeTheBackgroundCompaction,
+        ) {
+            Ok(drained) => drained,
+            Err(refusal) => {
+                match trigger {
+                    BackgroundCompactionTrigger::DueAfterAUserChange => {
+                        self.session.compaction.start_judgement =
+                            CompactionStartJudgement::DueAfterAUserChange;
+                    }
+                    BackgroundCompactionTrigger::TimerFallback => {}
+                }
+                return Err(
+                    BackgroundCompactionAfterThePendingChangesRefused::PublishOfThePendingChangesRefused(
+                        refusal,
+                    ),
+                );
+            }
+        };
+        let call = self.session.run_the_background_compaction_that_starts(
+            devices, pacing, caller, trigger, reach, budget,
+        );
+        let has_published = match &call {
+            BackgroundCompactionCall::Ran { run, .. } => !run.versions_published.is_empty(),
+            BackgroundCompactionCall::NotStarted(_) => false,
+        };
+        if has_published {
+            self.note_a_publish(now);
+        }
+        Ok(BackgroundCompactionAfterThePendingChanges {
+            pending_changes_published_before_the_run,
+            call,
+        })
+    }
+
+    /// 交出会话（卸载、回退、重发冻结的那一次要的是会话本身）：先把待发排空，交回排空那一次（待发空时 `None`）与会话。类型上卸载、回退之前待发一定空了
+    /// （判决第二节「一次发布里攒什么」那一格：回退、卸载是屏障）。
+    ///
+    /// # Errors
+    /// 排空没发成：[`HandingBackTheSessionRefused`]，攒批的会话原样交回（没冻结时待发还在里面）。
+    pub fn into_session_after_publishing_the_pending_changes<Device: BlockDevice>(
+        mut self,
+        devices: &mut Vec<(DeviceIdentity, Device)>,
+        now: CallerMonotonicClockReading,
+    ) -> Result<
+        (Option<PublishReportedByTheSession>, MountedSession),
+        Box<HandingBackTheSessionRefused>,
+    > {
+        self.note_the_reading_seen(now);
+        match self.publish_the_pending_changes(
+            devices,
+            now,
+            ReasonOfThePublish::PendingChangesPublishedBeforeHandingBackTheSession,
+        ) {
+            Ok(drained) => Ok((drained, self.session)),
+            Err(refusal) => Err(Box::new(HandingBackTheSessionRefused {
+                session_with_pending_changes: self,
+                refusal,
+            })),
+        }
+    }
+}
