+/// 发布触发的两个阈值在这次挂载里的有效值（D16（发布语义） 已定项 2、已定项 5）：挂载时求值一次、会话期间不变
+/// （`.claude/rules/fs-design.md` 五条硬要求第 5 条：分支变量是这两个阈值，`now` 与待发的 journal 字节是被比较的量）。
+///
+/// 时间那一支取系统运行配置里的 `T_time`（毫秒）；脏量那一支照已定项 5 夹一次：有效 `T_dirty` = min(系统运行配置里的 `T_dirty`, 环长 ÷ F)，
+/// 两边都是 journal 字节（脏量按待发改动要写的 journal 字节算，用户 2026-10-26 定）。挂载选项通道还没有（C422），产品路径只有
+/// [`PublishTriggerThresholds::of_the_mount`] 这一个来源；只供测试的那个来源（`.claude/rules/fs-design.md` 五条硬要求第 2 条：每条分支能被测试强制进入）
+/// 在默认关的 cargo 特性 `test-only-publish-thresholds` 后面，发布构建里调不到（判决 `research/prompts/m4-publish-trigger-r1-main-verification.md`
+/// 第二节「只供测试的开关」那一格）。只供测试的那个来源给的是夹之前的那个值，夹照常做（攻方 P6-乙：给有效值就跳过夹的那条分支）。
+///
+/// 发布构建里够不着那个来源，按编译期判：不开特性编本包时下面这一段必须编不过；开着特性编时它照常编得过、跑得对（两种编法各判一半，
+/// `cargo test -p singlefs-core --doc` 单编本包时特性关着，跑的是前一半）。
+///
+#[cfg_attr(not(feature = "test-only-publish-thresholds"), doc = "```compile_fail")]
+#[cfg_attr(feature = "test-only-publish-thresholds", doc = "```")]
+/// use singlefs_core::system_configuration::PublishTriggerThresholds;
+/// let thresholds = PublishTriggerThresholds::of_test_only_values_clamped_by_the_journal_ring(
+///     std::time::Duration::from_millis(3),
+///     8192,
+///     6 << 20,
+/// );
+/// assert_eq!(thresholds.time_threshold(), std::time::Duration::from_millis(3));
+/// assert_eq!(thresholds.dirty_threshold().0, 8192);
+/// ```
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct PublishTriggerThresholds {
+    time_threshold: std::time::Duration,
+    dirty_threshold: JournalBytesToWrite,
+}
+
+impl PublishTriggerThresholds {
+    /// 产品路径的有效值：系统运行配置里的两个值（`T_time` 5000 ms、`T_dirty` 2 GiB），`T_dirty` 按这个池的环长夹。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn of_the_mount(journal_ring_bytes: u64) -> Self {
+        let runtime = SystemRuntimeConfiguration;
+        Self::clamped_by_the_journal_ring(
+            std::time::Duration::from_millis(u64::from(runtime.time_threshold_milliseconds())),
+            runtime.dirty_threshold_bytes(),
+            journal_ring_bytes,
+        )
+    }
+
+    /// 只供测试的来源：把两个阈值压到测试的尺度（几毫秒、几条记录），无视 5 s 与 256 MiB 的判据强制进入时间那一支或脏量那一支。
+    /// `dirty_threshold_before_the_clamp` 是夹之前的值（与系统运行配置里那个字段同一个位置），有效值照样 min(它, 环长 ÷ F)。
+    /// 只在默认关的 cargo 特性 `test-only-publish-thresholds` 打开时编进来（harness 档的 dev 依赖打开它）：不开特性编的库里没有这个名字
+    /// （[`PublishTriggerThresholds`] 文档里那一段在那时编不过）。
+    #[cfg(feature = "test-only-publish-thresholds")]
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn of_test_only_values_clamped_by_the_journal_ring(
+        time_threshold: std::time::Duration,
+        dirty_threshold_before_the_clamp: u64,
+        journal_ring_bytes: u64,
+    ) -> Self {
+        Self::clamped_by_the_journal_ring(
+            time_threshold,
+            dirty_threshold_before_the_clamp,
+            journal_ring_bytes,
+        )
+    }
+
+    /// 已定项 5 的夹：有效 `T_dirty` = min(夹之前的值, 环长 ÷ F)。
+    fn clamped_by_the_journal_ring(
+        time_threshold: std::time::Duration,
+        dirty_threshold_before_the_clamp: u64,
+        journal_ring_bytes: u64,
+    ) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            time_threshold,
+            dirty_threshold: JournalBytesToWrite(
+                dirty_threshold_before_the_clamp.min(journal_ring_bytes / JOURNAL_SAFETY_FACTOR),
+            ),
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 时间那一支的阈值（`T_time`）。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn time_threshold(self) -> std::time::Duration {
+        self.time_threshold
+    }
+
+    /// 脏量那一支的有效阈值（夹过的 `T_dirty`，journal 字节）。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn dirty_threshold(self) -> JournalBytesToWrite {
+        self.dirty_threshold
+    }
+}

+/// 一次用户改动里建的 inode：几个、写进它们记录的时间秒。几次建 inode 并进一次发布时个数相加、时间秒逐次保留在各自那几条记录里
+/// （D16（发布语义） 已定项 10「建 inode 求和」）。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct NewInodesOfOneChange {
+    pub count: u64,
+    pub write_time_seconds: u64,
+}
+
+/// 按 inode 号整份写一个文件：同一个 inode 的几次写并进一次发布时折叠成最后那一次（D16（发布语义） 已定项 10「同一 inode 的写折叠」）。
+/// `inode` 是第一个文件（inode 1）时写的是 [`TransactionUnit::Data`] 那一族，同 [`publish_sequential_write`]；别的号同
+/// [`publish_sequential_write_of_an_inode`]。按切分纪律切成几个一单元事务（不按单元数拒）。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
+pub struct WholeWriteOfOneInode<'content> {
+    pub inode: InodeNumber,
+    pub content: &'content [u8],
+    pub write_time_seconds: u64,
+}
+
+/// 并进一次发布的数据写类改动（D16（发布语义） 已定项 10「数据写类可并：同一 inode 的写折叠、建 inode 求和」；会话的待发排空时交进来，
+/// `mounted_session::MountedSessionWithPendingChanges`）：至多一个文件的整份写（折叠过的），与按收下的次序的几次建 inode。
+/// 一次发布写一个文件以内是这一版发布计划的形状（[`PublishPlan::file`] 只装一个文件），不同 inode 的写不在同一次发布里——会话在收下时拒
+/// 第二个文件的写，不在这里拆。
+///
+/// 写的那个文件那条记录与新建的那几条一起写进 inode 树：写的那个号在上一版树里，新建的号从记账水位起发、都大于树里每一个 key，号严格升序。
+/// 事务照切分纪律：文件内容切成 N 个一单元事务、N 条记录，新建 inode 的记录与这次发布共享的提交内生块在最后一个事务的记录里点名；
+/// 没有文件写时整次发布一个事务（同 [`publish_new_inodes`]）。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
+pub struct DataChangesPublishedTogether<'content> {
+    pub whole_write: Option<WholeWriteOfOneInode<'content>>,
+    pub new_inodes: &'content [NewInodesOfOneChange],
+}
+
+impl DataChangesPublishedTogether<'_> {
+    /// 这一批里建的 inode 一共几个。
+    ///
+    /// # Panics
+    /// 个数之和装不进 u64：每一次的个数都是一次用户改动交进来的，加起来过 u64 说明调用方交的不是一批真改动。
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn new_inodes_in_total(&self) -> u64 {
+        self.new_inodes
+            .iter()
+            .try_fold(0_u64, |total, change| total.checked_add(change.count))
+            .expect("一批里建的 inode 个数之和装得进 u64")
+    }
+}
+
+/// 这一批要新建的那几条 inode 记录，按收下的次序：号从这一版的记账水位起连着发（只供测试的水位开关装着时从压回去的那个号起，C479，
+/// 与 [`publish_new_inodes`] 读同一个开关、同一份上一版），对象出生代与改动计数都是这次发布的 txg，时间秒是各自那一次改动交进来的。
+fn new_inode_records_of_data_changes_published_together<Device: BlockDevice>(
+    pool: &PoolWriter<'_, Device>,
+    previous: &TransactionOutput,
+    batch: &DataChangesPublishedTogether<'_>,
+    txg_of_the_batch: CheckpointTxg,
+) -> Vec<InodeRecord> {
+    let mut next_inode_number = pool
+        .inode_number_watermark_source()
+        .watermark_this_publish_starts_from(previous.inode_number_watermark());
+    let mut records_of_the_batch = Vec::new();
+    // 迭代上界是这一批的改动数乘各自的个数；跨轮携带的是下一个要发的号（只增）。
+    for change in batch.new_inodes {
+        for _created_in_this_change in 0..change.count {
+            records_of_the_batch.push(InodeRecord {
+                inode: next_inode_number,
+                object_birth: txg_of_the_batch,
+                nlink: NLINK_OF_A_LIVE_INODE_WITHOUT_DIRECTORIES,
+                size: 0,
+                change_count: txg_of_the_batch.0,
+                write_time_seconds: change.write_time_seconds,
+                truncation_field: InodeRecordTruncationField::NOT_WRITTEN,
+            });
+            next_inode_number = next_inode_number
+                .checked_add(1)
+                .expect("inode 号水位装得进 u64：号从记账水位起发，水位本身是这一版记账里读出的");
+        }
+    }
+    records_of_the_batch
+}
+
+/// 这一批那一次发布的计划：接在 `previous` 后面，txg、jsn、事务号各接着走；写的那个文件照它是不是第一个文件分两路判（第一个文件要活着；
+/// 别的号要在树里、不在删除中、不是第一个文件删完之后才建的，[`plan_of_a_whole_write_of_a_file_other_than_the_first`]），新建的记录由调用方
+/// 照 [`new_inode_records_of_data_changes_published_together`] 先算好交进来。只读上一版的内存态。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// `WriteToAnInodeThatIsNotInTheTree`、`WriteToAnInodeBeingDeleted`、`DataWriteToAnInodeBornAfterTheFirstFileWasDeletedIsOutsideTheFirstVersion`、
+/// `NextCheckpointTxgPastTheTopOfItsRange`，都在任何读写之前。
+///
+/// # Panics
+/// 写的是第一个文件之外的号而上一版的承诺类意图队列不空（同 [`publish_sequential_write_of_an_inode`]：会话先走空）。
+fn plan_of_data_changes_published_together<'content>(
+    previous: &TransactionOutput,
+    batch: &DataChangesPublishedTogether<'content>,
+    new_inode_records: &'content [InodeRecord],
+    instance: InstanceGeneration,
+) -> Result<PublishPlan<'content>, PublishError> {
+    let txg_of_the_batch = checkpoint_txg_of_the_publish_after(previous.root.checkpoint_txg)?;
+    let file_of_the_batch = match batch.whole_write {
+        None => None,
+        Some(whole_write) if whole_write.inode.0 == FIRST_INODE_NUMBER => {
+            let record_of_the_first_file = live_record_of_the_first_file(previous)?;
+            Some(FileVersionPlan {
+                inode: whole_write.inode,
+                content: whole_write.content,
+                write_time_seconds: whole_write.write_time_seconds,
+                // 对象出生代不改（D8（核心索引结构） 已定项 6）；改动计数取这次发布的 txg。
+                inode_object_birth: record_of_the_first_file.object_birth,
+                change_count: txg_of_the_batch.0,
+            })
+        }
+        Some(whole_write) => {
+            plan_of_a_whole_write_of_a_file_other_than_the_first(
+                previous,
+                whole_write.inode,
+                whole_write.content,
+                whole_write.write_time_seconds,
+                instance,
+            )?
+            .file
+        }
+    };
+    let first_transaction_of_the_batch = previous.highest_transaction_number_in_this_instance + 1;
+    Ok(PublishPlan {
+        txg: txg_of_the_batch,
+        counter: previous.record.counter + 1,
+        transaction: first_transaction_of_the_batch,
+        highest_transaction_number_before_this_publish: previous
+            .highest_transaction_number_in_this_instance,
+        instance,
+        back_chain: back_chain_of(&previous.record_bytes),
+        file: file_of_the_batch,
+        new_inode_records,
+        instance_table: InstanceTablePlan::Carry(previous.root.instance_table),
+        tree_birth_txg: previous.tree_birth_txg(),
+        // 这次一个树 ID 都不发：上一版的水位就是根环里全部根记录的 max。
+        tree_identifier_watermark: previous.root.tree_identifier_watermark,
+        rollback_floor: previous.root.rollback_floor,
+    })
+}
+
+/// 并在一起的数据写类改动发成一次发布（[`DataChangesPublishedTogether`]，会话的待发排空走这一条）：走 [`publish_version`] 那一条发布路径
+/// （`.claude/rules/fs-design.md`「一个事务层，所有结构共用」：这里不另开一条）。只有一个文件写、没有建 inode 时写出的字节与同内容的
+/// [`publish_sequential_write_of_an_inode`] 一个不差；只有建 inode、各次时间秒相同时与同个数的 [`publish_new_inodes`] 一个不差。
+///
+/// # Errors
+/// 计划那几种（[`plan_of_data_changes_published_together`]），其余同 [`publish_version`]（冻结、准入、落点、释放判定、记录条数、块设备错）。

+/// # Panics
+/// 同 [`plan_of_data_changes_published_together`]。
+pub fn publish_data_changes_published_together<Device: BlockDevice>(
+    pool: &mut PoolWriter<'_, Device>,
+    allocator: &mut PoolAllocator,
+    previous: &TransactionOutput,
+    batch: DataChangesPublishedTogether<'_>,
+    instance: InstanceGeneration,
+) -> Result<TransactionOutput, PublishError> {
+    let txg_of_the_batch = checkpoint_txg_of_the_publish_after(previous.root.checkpoint_txg)?;
+    let new_inode_records = new_inode_records_of_data_changes_published_together(
+        pool,
+        previous,
+        &batch,
+        txg_of_the_batch,
+    );
+    let plan =
+        plan_of_data_changes_published_together(previous, &batch, &new_inode_records, instance)?;
+    publish_version(pool, allocator, plan, Some(previous))

+            &&& user_version_is_a_candidate(crashed_without_compaction.roots, crashed_without_compaction.in_memory_floor, 2)
+            &&& !user_version_is_a_candidate(crashed_with_compaction.roots, crashed_with_compaction.in_memory_floor, 0)
+            &&& user_version_is_a_candidate(crashed_with_compaction.roots, crashed_with_compaction.in_memory_floor, 1)

+    let state = ring_state_of(

+        seq![
+            RingRoot { view, name: RootName::UserVersion { version: 0 } },
+            RingRoot { view, name: RootName::UserVersion { version: 1 } },
+            RingRoot { view, name: RootName::UserVersion { version: 2 } },

+    assert(target == 2) by {

+    let compacted = run_ring_next(raised, RunRingStep::CompactionCheckpoint);

+    assert(in_memory_floor_after_a_compaction_publish(raised) == 2);
+    assert(compacted.persisted_floor == 1);
+    let crashed_with_compaction = run_ring_next(compacted, RunRingStep::Crash);
+    assert(crashed_with_compaction.in_memory_floor == 1);
+    assert(crashed_with_compaction.roots.len() == 4);
+    lemma_observed_roots_keep_each_root(crashed_with_compaction.roots);
+    assert(crashed_with_compaction.roots[1] == state.roots[1]);
+    assert(crashed_with_compaction.roots[2] == state.roots[2]);
+    assert(crashed_with_compaction.roots[3].name == RootName::CompactionPublish);
+    assert(observed_roots_of(crashed_with_compaction.roots)[1].name == (RootName::UserVersion { version: 1 }));
+    assert(observed_roots_of(crashed_with_compaction.roots)[2].name == (RootName::UserVersion { version: 2 }));
+    assert(!user_version_is_a_candidate(crashed_with_compaction.roots, crashed_with_compaction.in_memory_floor, 0)) by {
+        assert forall|index: int| crashed_with_compaction.in_memory_floor <= index < crashed_with_compaction.roots.len() implies (

+            assert(index == 1 || index == 2 || index == 3);
+        }
+    }

+//!
+//! 每个 core 值的 `View`（把运行时的分配器、映射、根环投影成这里的模型）照门禁「被验类型的 trait impl 一律写在 `verus!` 里」写在定义它的
+//! 那份文件里，由那份文件所在的簇写。
+use vstd::prelude::*;
+
+use crate::address::{CheckpointTxg, DeviceIdentity, SlotNumber};
+
+verus! {
+
+// ===== singlefs-format 常量的规格 =====
+// Verus 不认没进 verus! 的 crate 里的常量（直接引报「`singlefs_format::SLOT_BYTES` is not supported」），所以被验区域用到的格式常量
+// 在这里各写一条 assume_specification，交回它在 singlefs-format 里的值。每一条登记进信任清单 .claude/gate.d/verus-trust-list.tsv，
+// 差分测试是本文件 tests 模块的 every_format_constant_specification_returns_the_value_singlefs_format_defines：它读这份文件里每一条
+// 这样的声明，与 singlefs-format 的真值逐个比，值写错、或少配一个名字都红。
+// 一个常量只写一条，都写在这一段：后面的簇要用别的格式常量，在这里加一条、在 tests 模块的名字表里加它的名字、在信任清单里登记一行。
+// Verus 编的时候把 assume_specification 展开成一个 unsafe 的 fn 声明，撞 lib.rs 的 deny(unsafe_code)，所以每一条各带一个 allow；
+// 平时的 cargo build 把整条擦掉，产品代码里没有它。
+#[allow(unsafe_code, reason = "Verus 把 assume_specification 展开成 unsafe fn 声明；只在 Verus 编的时候有，产品构建里擦掉")]
+pub assume_specification[ singlefs_format::SLOT_BYTES ] -> (slot_bytes: u64) returns 16384u64;
+#[allow(unsafe_code, reason = "Verus 把 assume_specification 展开成 unsafe fn 声明；只在 Verus 编的时候有，产品构建里擦掉")]
+pub assume_specification[ singlefs_format::MAPPING_KEY_BYTES ] -> (mapping_key_bytes: u64) returns 27u64;
+
+// ===== 槽区间 =====
+// 一个单元在一块盘上占的槽：起点加跨度（槽数）。对到 gc_ring_interval_proofs 的 SlotRun：那里起点与跨度是 int、不带设备，
+// 这里起点是 core 的 SlotNumber（u64），接协议核时要另证起点加跨度不越过 u64（slot_run_fits_in_u64）。
+pub struct SlotRunModel {
+    pub start: SlotNumber,
+    pub span_slots: nat,
+}
+
+pub open spec fn slot_run_end(run: SlotRunModel) -> int {
+    run.start.0 + run.span_slots
+}
+
+pub open spec fn slot_run_fits_in_u64(run: SlotRunModel) -> bool {
+    &&& run.span_slots >= 1
+    &&& slot_run_end(run) <= u64::MAX
+}
+
+// 对到 gc_ring_interval_proofs 的 run_covers。
+pub open spec fn slot_run_covers(run: SlotRunModel, slot: SlotNumber) -> bool {
+    run.start.0 <= slot.0 && slot.0 < slot_run_end(run)
+}
+
+// 对到 gc_ring_interval_proofs 的 runs_overlap。
+pub open spec fn slot_runs_overlap(this_run: SlotRunModel, other_run: SlotRunModel) -> bool {
+    this_run.start.0 < slot_run_end(other_run) && other_run.start.0 < slot_run_end(this_run)
+}
+
+// ===== 分配器记录 =====
+// 一条分配记录在它的生命里处在哪一种：仍分配（带分配代）、仍分配而被隔离（隔离记号置上，分配代不变）、已释放（带释放代）。
+// 已释放的记录不带隔离记号（D19（块指针的结构与宽度预算）已定项 5「带记号的记录必须未释放」），所以没有「已释放而被隔离」这一种。
+pub enum AllocationRecordLifeModel {
+    Allocated { allocation_generation: CheckpointTxg },
+    AllocatedAndQuarantined { allocation_generation: CheckpointTxg },
+    Released { release_generation: CheckpointTxg },
+}
+
+// 分配记录 20（D3（空间分配）已定项 7 / 已定项 11）的模型：哪块盘、罩住哪一段槽、处在哪一种生命。
+pub struct AllocationRecordModel {
+    pub device: DeviceIdentity,
+    pub run: SlotRunModel,
+    pub life: AllocationRecordLifeModel,
+}
+
+// 分配记录树的 key：(设备身份, 起点槽号)，与 allocator.rs 里 AllocationRecord::sort_key 同序。
+pub struct AllocationRecordKeyModel {
+    pub device: DeviceIdentity,
+    pub start: SlotNumber,
+}
+
+// 分配器的记录账：key 到记录。
+pub struct AllocatorRecordsModel {
+    pub records: Map<AllocationRecordKeyModel, AllocationRecordModel>,
+}
+
+pub open spec fn record_is_keyed_by_its_start(key: AllocationRecordKeyModel, record: AllocationRecordModel) -> bool {
+    key.device == record.device && key.start == record.run.start
+}
+
+pub open spec fn records_are_keyed_by_their_start(records: AllocatorRecordsModel) -> bool {
+    forall|key: AllocationRecordKeyModel| records.records.contains_key(key)
+        ==> record_is_keyed_by_its_start(key, #[trigger] records.records[key])
+}
+
+// I-5.4（分配记录罩住的槽互不相交）：同一块盘上两条不同的记录，罩住的槽不重叠。
+pub open spec fn records_on_one_device_are_disjoint(records: AllocatorRecordsModel) -> bool {
+    forall|this_key: AllocationRecordKeyModel, other_key: AllocationRecordKeyModel|
+        #![trigger records.records[this_key], records.records[other_key]]
+        records.records.contains_key(this_key) && records.records.contains_key(other_key) && this_key != other_key
+            && this_key.device == other_key.device
+            ==> !slot_runs_overlap(records.records[this_key].run, records.records[other_key].run)
+}
+
+pub open spec fn record_is_released(record: AllocationRecordModel) -> bool {
+    record.life matches AllocationRecordLifeModel::Released { .. }
+}
+
+// 回收门槛：已释放、释放代不大于 floor。对到 gc_crash_proofs 的 released_record_can_be_reclaimed（产品经它判，allocator.rs 回收时调它）
+// 那条 ensures 的 released && generation <= floor；那里的 generation 与 floor 是裸 u64，这里是 CheckpointTxg。
+pub open spec fn record_can_be_reclaimed_under_the_floor(record: AllocationRecordModel, floor: CheckpointTxg) -> bool {
+    match record.life {
+        AllocationRecordLifeModel::Allocated { .. } => false,
+        AllocationRecordLifeModel::AllocatedAndQuarantined { .. } => false,
+        AllocationRecordLifeModel::Released { release_generation } => release_generation.0 <= floor.0,
+    }
+}
+
+// 这块盘上这个槽被一条没释放的记录罩着（仍分配，或仍分配而被隔离）。
+pub open spec fn slot_is_allocated_on_the_device(records: AllocatorRecordsModel, device: DeviceIdentity, slot: SlotNumber) -> bool {
+    exists|key: AllocationRecordKeyModel|
+        records.records.contains_key(key) && key.device == device && slot_run_covers((#[trigger] records.records[key]).run, slot)
+            && !record_is_released(records.records[key])
+}
+
+// ===== 中央映射 =====
+// 中央映射里一条的一个位置：哪块盘、哪一段槽（D19（块指针的结构与宽度预算）已定项 10 的位置条目）。
+pub struct MappingLocationModel {
+    pub device: DeviceIdentity,
+    pub run: SlotRunModel,
+}
+
+// 中央映射里一条的值：两条位置条目，两盘同槽（D2（RAID 条带策略）已定项 10：一个单元整个落在一列上、两盘各一份）。
+pub struct MappingValueModel {
+    pub copies: Seq<MappingLocationModel>,
+}
+
+pub open spec fn mapping_value_has_one_copy_on_each_of_two_devices(value: MappingValueModel) -> bool {
+    &&& value.copies.len() == 2
+    &&& value.copies[0].device != value.copies[1].device
+    &&& value.copies[0].run == value.copies[1].run
+    &&& slot_run_fits_in_u64(value.copies[0].run)
+}
+
+// 一版的中央映射：映射 key（MAPPING_KEY_BYTES 字节）到值。对到 gc_ring_interval_proofs 的 RunView 的 mapping：那里 key 是 u64、值是一段 SlotRun，
+// 这里 key 是盘上的字节串、值是两盘同槽的两份；接协议核时由后面的簇给出 key 的单射与「两份同槽」到一段 SlotRun 的投影。
+pub struct CentralMappingModel {
+    pub entries: Map<Seq<u8>, MappingValueModel>,
+}
+
+pub open spec fn central_mapping_is_shaped(mapping: CentralMappingModel) -> bool {
+    forall|key: Seq<u8>| mapping.entries.contains_key(key)
+        ==> key.len() == singlefs_format::MAPPING_KEY_BYTES && mapping_value_has_one_copy_on_each_of_two_devices(#[trigger] mapping.entries[key])
+}
+
+// 对到 gc_ring_interval_proofs 的 mapping_avoids_slot：映射里没有一条在这块盘上罩住这个槽。
+pub open spec fn central_mapping_avoids_the_slot(mapping: CentralMappingModel, device: DeviceIdentity, slot: SlotNumber) -> bool {
+    forall|key: Seq<u8>, copy: int| mapping.entries.contains_key(key) && 0 <= copy < mapping.entries[key].copies.len()
+        && (#[trigger] mapping.entries[key].copies[copy]).device == device
+        ==> !slot_run_covers(mapping.entries[key].copies[copy].run, slot)
+}
+
+// ===== 根环与两层 F =====
+// 根是谁发的：用户那一侧的发布（用户点得到它的版本），或整理的发布（占根环的一个根，用户点不到）。
+// 对到 gc_ring_interval_proofs 的 RootName：那里用户的根带的是协议的版本号，这里带的是根记录的 checkpoint 号。
+pub enum RootPublisherModel {
+    UserPublish,
+    CompactionPublish,
+}
+
+// 根环里一条持久的根：根记录的 checkpoint 号、它带着的回退下界 F（root_record.rs 的 RootRecord::rollback_floor）、它那一版的中央映射、谁发的。
+// 对到 gc_ring_interval_proofs 的 RingRoot。
+pub struct RingRootModel {
+    pub checkpoint_txg: CheckpointTxg,
+    pub rollback_floor: CheckpointTxg,
+    pub mapping: CentralMappingModel,
+    pub publisher: RootPublisherModel,
+}
+
+// 根环与两层 F。对到 gc_ring_interval_proofs 的 RunRingState：
+// - roots 旧到新，最后一条是崩溃后重现的那一条；
+// - in_memory_floor 是内存 F（回退候选的下界），persisted_floor 是持久 F（最后一条持久的根带着的 F，回收与覆写要避开它之上的每个根）；
+//   协议里两层 F 是根序列的下标，这里是 checkpoint 号，对上要另证根的 checkpoint 号严格递增（roots_ascend_by_checkpoint_txg）；
+// - head 是内存里的现行映射，可以领先最后一条持久的根；
+// - window 是根环容得下的根数。
+// 抬 F 先只改内存 F，带新 F 的根落满每块盘之后持久 F 才跟上（allocator.rs 的 hold_until_floor_takes_effect 与 release_reclaim_holds 扣住、
+// 放开回收出来的槽）；崩溃让内存 F 回到持久 F（root_ring_after_a_crash）。
+pub struct RootRingModel {
+    pub roots: Seq<RingRootModel>,
+    pub in_memory_floor: CheckpointTxg,
+    pub persisted_floor: CheckpointTxg,
+    pub head: CentralMappingModel,
+    pub window: nat,
+}
+
+pub open spec fn roots_ascend_by_checkpoint_txg(roots: Seq<RingRootModel>) -> bool {
+    forall|earlier: int, later: int|
+        #![trigger roots[earlier], roots[later]]
+        0 <= earlier < later < roots.len() ==> roots[earlier].checkpoint_txg.0 < roots[later].checkpoint_txg.0
+}
+
+// 对到 gc_ring_interval_proofs 的 run_ring_is_shaped。
+pub open spec fn root_ring_is_shaped(ring: RootRingModel) -> bool {
+    &&& ring.roots.len() >= 1
+    &&& ring.window >= 1
+    &&& roots_ascend_by_checkpoint_txg(ring.roots)
+    &&& ring.persisted_floor == ring.roots.last().rollback_floor
+    &&& ring.persisted_floor.0 <= ring.in_memory_floor.0
+}
+
+// 持久 F 之上的根：回收与覆写要避开它们罩着的每个槽。
+pub open spec fn root_is_protected(ring: RootRingModel, index: int) -> bool {
+    0 <= index < ring.roots.len() && ring.persisted_floor.0 <= ring.roots[index].checkpoint_txg.0
+}
+
+// 回退候选：内存 F 之上、用户那一侧发的根。
+pub open spec fn root_is_a_rollback_candidate(ring: RootRingModel, index: int) -> bool {
+    &&& 0 <= index < ring.roots.len()
+    &&& ring.in_memory_floor.0 <= ring.roots[index].checkpoint_txg.0
+    &&& ring.roots[index].publisher matches RootPublisherModel::UserPublish
+}
+
+// 对到 gc_ring_interval_proofs 的 slot_is_unreferenced（读者那一项在会话那一侧，不在这个模型里）：现行映射与持久 F 之上的每个根都没罩住这个槽。
+pub open spec fn slot_is_unreferenced_by_the_ring(ring: RootRingModel, device: DeviceIdentity, slot: SlotNumber) -> bool {
+    &&& central_mapping_avoids_the_slot(ring.head, device, slot)
+    &&& forall|index: int| root_is_protected(ring, index)
+        ==> central_mapping_avoids_the_slot((#[trigger] ring.roots[index]).mapping, device, slot)
+}
+
+// 崩溃之后：内存 F 回到持久 F，现行映射回到最后一条持久的根那一版。对到 gc_ring_interval_proofs 里 RunRingStep::Crash 那一步。
+pub open spec fn root_ring_after_a_crash(ring: RootRingModel) -> RootRingModel {
+    RootRingModel {
+        roots: ring.roots,
+        in_memory_floor: ring.persisted_floor,
+        persisted_floor: ring.persisted_floor,
+        head: ring.roots.last().mapping,
+        window: ring.window,
+    }
+}
+
+} // verus!
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    /// 规格里写了 `assume_specification` 的格式常量：名字与 `singlefs-format` 里的真值。
+    /// 新加一条 `assume_specification` 时在这里加它的名字，没配上的那一边测试照样红。
+    const FORMAT_CONSTANTS_WITH_A_VERUS_SPECIFICATION: [(&str, u64); 2] = [
+        ("SLOT_BYTES", singlefs_format::SLOT_BYTES),
+        ("MAPPING_KEY_BYTES", singlefs_format::MAPPING_KEY_BYTES),
+    ];
+
+    /// 这份文件 `verus!` 里每一条 `pub assume_specification[ singlefs_format::<名> ] -> (…) returns <值>;`：名字与 `returns` 后面的值。
+    /// 只读 `tests` 模块之前那一截，这里写的模式与字符串不算。
+    fn format_constant_specifications_in_this_file() -> Vec<(String, u64)> {
+        let source = include_str!("verified_model.rs");
+        let (verified_region, _tests) = source
+            .split_once("\n#[cfg(test)]\n")
+            .expect("这份文件里有 tests 模块，它的 #[cfg(test)] 单独占一行");
+        verified_region
+            .lines()
+            .map(str::trim)
+            .filter_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("pub assume_specification[ singlefs_format::"))
+            .map(|rest| {
+                let (name, after_name) = rest
+                    .split_once(" ]")
+                    .expect("格式常量的 assume_specification 写成「[ singlefs_format::<名> ]」");
+                let (_returned_binding, value_text) = after_name
+                    .split_once(" returns ")
+                    .expect("格式常量的 assume_specification 用 returns 交回值");
+                let digits: String = value_text
+                    .trim_end_matches(';')
+                    .trim_end_matches("u64")
+                    .trim_end_matches("u8")
+                    .chars()
+                    .filter(|character| *character != '_')
+                    .collect();
+                let value = digits
+                    .parse::<u64>()
+                    .expect("returns 后面是一个带类型后缀的十进制整数");
+                (name.to_owned(), value)
+            })
+            .collect()
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn every_format_constant_specification_returns_the_value_singlefs_format_defines() {
+        let specified = format_constant_specifications_in_this_file();
+        let mut specified_names: Vec<&str> = specified
+            .iter()
+            .map(|(name, _value)| name.as_str())
+            .collect();
+        specified_names.sort_unstable();
+        let mut listed_names: Vec<&str> = FORMAT_CONSTANTS_WITH_A_VERUS_SPECIFICATION
+            .iter()
+            .map(|(name, _value)| *name)
+            .collect();
+        listed_names.sort_unstable();
+        assert_eq!(
+            specified_names, listed_names,
+            "verus! 里写了 assume_specification 的格式常量与测试里列的名字要逐个相同"
+        );
+        for (name, specified_value) in &specified {
+            let (_listed_name, actual_value) = FORMAT_CONSTANTS_WITH_A_VERUS_SPECIFICATION
+                .iter()
+                .find(|(listed_name, _value)| listed_name == name)
+                .expect("上面判过两边名字逐个相同");
+            assert_eq!(
+                specified_value, actual_value,
+                "singlefs_format::{name} 的 assume_specification 交回 {specified_value}，singlefs-format 里定义的是 {actual_value}"
+            );
+        }
+    }
+}
````

+    struct SourceLocation {
+        path_from_repository_root: String,
+        line_number: usize,
+    }
+
+    impl fmt::Display for SourceLocation {

+    struct RustSource {

+    /// 一条声明：关键字所在的位置，与从关键字起到同一层的 `;` 为止的那一截（注释与字面量已换成空格，连续空白并成一个空格）。
+    struct DeclarationText {
+        location: SourceLocation,
+        text: String,
+    }

+    /// singlefs-format 源码里的一行 `pub const <名>: <类型> = <右边>;`。

+        location: SourceLocation,

+        right_hand_side: String,
+    }

+    /// core 里一条点名 `singlefs_format::<名>` 的规格。`declared_type` 是 `->` 写的交回类型。
+    struct FormatConstantSpecification {

+        name: String,
+        declared_type: String,
+        returned_literal: String,

+    /// 一条 `assume_specification` 读出来是什么。
+    enum SpecificationReading {
+        FormatConstant(FormatConstantSpecification),
+        /// 方括号里不是 `singlefs_format::` 起头的路径（别的外部函数的规格），不归这条测试比，只看它是不是绕开了全路径的格式常量。
+        OtherPath {
+            location: SourceLocation,
+            path: String,
+        },
+        Unreadable {
+            location: SourceLocation,
+            reason: &'static str,
+            text: String,
+        },
+    }
+
+    /// 判红的每一种。
+    enum SpecificationInconsistency {
+        SpecifiedMoreThanOnce {
+            name: String,
+            locations: Vec<SourceLocation>,
+        },
+        ValueDiffersFromFormat {
+            specification: SourceLocation,
+            name: String,
+            specified_value: u128,
+            definition: SourceLocation,
+            defined_value: u128,
+        },
+        ConstantMissingInFormat {
+            specification: SourceLocation,
+            name: String,
+        },
+        ConstantDefinedMoreThanOnceInFormat {
+            specification: SourceLocation,
+            name: String,
+            definitions: Vec<SourceLocation>,
+        },
+        FormatDefinitionIsNotAnIntegerLiteral {
+            specification: SourceLocation,
+            name: String,
+            definition: SourceLocation,
+            type_name: String,
+            right_hand_side: String,
+        },
+        TypeDiffersFromFormat {

+        SpecificationUnreadable {

+        FormatConstantNamedWithoutFullPath {

+    impl fmt::Display for SpecificationInconsistency {

+                }
+                Self::ValueDiffersFromFormat { specification, name, specified_value, definition, defined_value } => write!(

+                Self::ConstantMissingInFormat { specification, name } => write!(
+                    formatter,

+                Self::ConstantDefinedMoreThanOnceInFormat { specification, name, definitions } => {

+                ),
+                Self::TypeDiffersFromFormat { specification, name, which_type, specified_type, format_type } => write!(

+                ),
+                Self::ReturnedValueIsNotAnIntegerLiteral { specification, name, returned_literal } => write!(

+                ),
+                Self::SpecificationUnreadable { location, reason, text } => write!(

+                ),

+    /// 一个目录下的全部 `.rs`（逐层往下），按路径排好；路径从仓根写起，报红时给 文件:行。
+    fn read_rust_sources_under(
+        directory: &Path,
+        path_from_repository_root: &str,
+    ) -> Vec<RustSource> {
+        let mut entry_paths: Vec<std::path::PathBuf> = std::fs::read_dir(directory)
+            .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("读不了源码目录 {}：{error}", directory.display()))
+            .map(|entry| {
+                entry
+                    .unwrap_or_else(|error| {
+                        panic!("读不了源码目录 {} 的一项：{error}", directory.display())
+                    })
+                    .path()
             })
+            .collect();
+        entry_paths.sort();
+        let mut sources = Vec::new();
+        for entry_path in entry_paths {
+            let file_name = entry_path
+                .file_name()
+                .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
+                .expect("源码目录下的文件名是 UTF-8");
+            let entry_path_from_repository_root =
+                format!("{path_from_repository_root}/{file_name}");
+            if entry_path.is_dir() {
+                sources.extend(read_rust_sources_under(
+                    &entry_path,
+                    &entry_path_from_repository_root,
+                ));
+            } else if entry_path
+                .extension()
+                .is_some_and(|extension| extension == "rs")
+            {
+                let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&entry_path).unwrap_or_else(|error| {
+                    panic!("读不了 {entry_path_from_repository_root}：{error}")
+                });
+                sources.push(RustSource {
+                    path_from_repository_root: entry_path_from_repository_root,
+                    text,
+                });
+            }
+        }
+        sources
+    }
+
+    fn is_identifier_character(character: char) -> bool {
+        character.is_alphanumeric() || character == '_'
+    }
+
+    /// `start` 处起头的若是注释、字符串或字符字面量，交回它结束之后的下标；不是（代码、生命周期、标签）交回 None。
+    fn end_of_comment_or_literal_starting_at(characters: &[char], start: usize) -> Option<usize> {
+        let character_at = |offset: usize| characters.get(start + offset).copied();
+        let character_before = |offset: usize| {
+            start
+                .checked_sub(offset)
+                .and_then(|index| characters.get(index))
+                .copied()
+        };
+        let current = character_at(0)?;
+        if current == '/' && character_at(1) == Some('/') {
+            let line_end = characters[start..]
+                .iter()
+                .position(|character| *character == '\n')
+                .map_or(characters.len(), |offset| start + offset);
+            return Some(line_end);
+        }
+        if current == '/' && character_at(1) == Some('*') {
+            let mut depth = 0_usize;
+            let mut position = start;
+            while position < characters.len() {
+                if characters[position] == '/' && characters.get(position + 1) == Some(&'*') {
+                    depth += 1;
+                    position += 2;
+                } else if characters[position] == '*' && characters.get(position + 1) == Some(&'/')
+                {
+                    depth -= 1;
+                    position += 2;
+                    if depth == 0 {
+                        return Some(position);
+                    }
+                } else {
+                    position += 1;
+                }
+            }
+            return Some(characters.len());
+        }
+        if current == '"' {
+            let mut position = start + 1;
+            while position < characters.len() {
+                match characters[position] {
+                    '\\' => position += 2,
+                    '"' => return Some(position + 1),
+                    _ => position += 1,
+                }
+            }
+            return Some(characters.len());
+        }
+        if current == 'r' {
+            // 原始字符串 r"…"、r#"…"#、br#"…"#：r 前面不接标识符（b 前缀除外）、后面是若干个 # 再接 "。
+            let starts_a_token = match character_before(1) {
+                None => true,
+                Some('b') => !character_before(2).is_some_and(is_identifier_character),
+                Some(previous) => !is_identifier_character(previous),
+            };
+            if !starts_a_token {
+                return None;
+            }
+            let hash_count = characters[start + 1..]
+                .iter()
+                .take_while(|character| **character == '#')
+                .count();
+            if characters.get(start + 1 + hash_count) != Some(&'"') {
+                return None;
+            }
+            let mut position = start + 2 + hash_count;
+            while position < characters.len() {
+                let closes = characters[position] == '"'
+                    && (1..=hash_count)
+                        .all(|offset| characters.get(position + offset) == Some(&'#'));
+                if closes {
+                    return Some(position + 1 + hash_count);
+                }
+                position += 1;
+            }
+            return Some(characters.len());
+        }
+        if current == '\'' {
+            if character_at(1) == Some('\\') {
+                // 转义的字符字面量：跳过反斜杠后面那一个字，再找收尾的单引号（'\''、'\u{…}' 都对）。
+                let closing = characters
+                    .get(start + 3..)
+                    .unwrap_or(&[])
+                    .iter()
+                    .position(|character| *character == '\'')
+                    .map_or(characters.len(), |offset| start + 3 + offset + 1);
+                return Some(closing);
+            }
+            if character_at(2) == Some('\'') {
+                return Some(start + 3);
+            }
+            return None;
+        }
+        None
+    }
+
+    /// 注释、字符串与字符字面量换成空格，换行照留：行号不变，注释与字面量里的字也不被当成代码认。
+    fn blank_comments_and_literals(source: &str) -> String {
+        let characters: Vec<char> = source.chars().collect();
+        let mut blanked = String::with_capacity(source.len());
+        let mut position = 0;
+        while position < characters.len() {
+            if let Some(end) = end_of_comment_or_literal_starting_at(&characters, position) {
+                for character in &characters[position..end] {
+                    blanked.push(if *character == '\n' { '\n' } else { ' ' });
+                }
+                position = end;
+            } else {
+                blanked.push(characters[position]);
+                position += 1;
+            }
+        }
+        blanked
+    }
+
+    /// `text` 里 `open_position` 处的开括号配对的闭括号的下标（只数同一种括号）。
+    fn matching_close_position(
+        text: &str,
+        open_position: usize,
+        open: char,
+        close: char,
+    ) -> Option<usize> {
+        let mut depth = 0_usize;
+        for (offset, character) in text[open_position..].char_indices() {
+            if character == open {
+                depth += 1;
+            } else if character == close {
+                depth -= 1;
+                if depth == 0 {
+                    return Some(open_position + offset);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        None
+    }
+
+    /// 已去掉注释与字面量的源码里每一处整词 `word`：从它起到同一层括号里第一个 `;` 为止（包括 `;`）。
+    fn declarations_starting_with_word(
+        blanked_source: &str,
+        word: &str,
+        path_from_repository_root: &str,
+    ) -> Vec<DeclarationText> {
+        let mut declarations = Vec::new();
+        for (word_position, _matched) in blanked_source.match_indices(word) {
+            let is_whole_word_start = !blanked_source[..word_position]
+                .chars()
+                .next_back()
+                .is_some_and(is_identifier_character);
+            let is_whole_word_end = !blanked_source[word_position + word.len()..]
+                .chars()
+                .next()
+                .is_some_and(is_identifier_character);
+            if !(is_whole_word_start && is_whole_word_end) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            let mut bracket_depth = 0_i64;
+            let mut declaration_end = blanked_source.len();
+            for (offset, character) in blanked_source[word_position..].char_indices() {
+                match character {
+                    '(' | '[' | '{' => bracket_depth += 1,
+                    ')' | ']' | '}' => bracket_depth -= 1,
+                    ';' if bracket_depth == 0 => {
+                        declaration_end = word_position + offset + 1;
+                        break;
+                    }
+                    _ => {}
+                }
+            }
+            let text = blanked_source[word_position..declaration_end]
+                .split_whitespace()
+                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+                .join(" ");
+            let line_number = 1 + blanked_source[..word_position].matches('\n').count();
+            declarations.push(DeclarationText {
+                location: SourceLocation {
+                    path_from_repository_root: path_from_repository_root.to_owned(),
+                    line_number,
+                },
+                text,
+            });
+        }
+        declarations
+    }
+
+    fn without_whitespace(text: &str) -> String {
+        text.chars()
+            .filter(|character| !character.is_whitespace())
             .collect()
     }
 
+    /// 整数字面量的值与类型后缀（没写后缀是 None）；不是整数字面量（算式、浮点、别的后缀）交回 None。
+    fn parse_integer_literal(text: &str) -> Option<(u128, Option<&str>)> {
+        let (radix, body) = if let Some(hexadecimal) = text.strip_prefix("0x") {
+            (16, hexadecimal)
+        } else if let Some(octal) = text.strip_prefix("0o") {
+            (8, octal)
+        } else if let Some(binary) = text.strip_prefix("0b") {
+            (2, binary)
+        } else {
+            (10, text)
+        };
+        let digits_end = body
+            .find(|character: char| !(character == '_' || character.is_digit(radix)))
+            .unwrap_or(body.len());
+        let (digits, suffix) = body.split_at(digits_end);
+        let digits_without_separators: String = digits
+            .chars()
+            .filter(|character| *character != '_')
+            .collect();
+        if digits_without_separators.is_empty() {
+            return None;
+        }
+        let value = u128::from_str_radix(&digits_without_separators, radix).ok()?;
+        if suffix.is_empty() {
+            return Some((value, None));
+        }
+        INTEGER_TYPE_NAMES
+            .contains(&suffix)
+            .then_some((value, Some(suffix)))
+    }

+    /// singlefs-format 源码里每一个 `pub const`，按名字收（同名几处都留着，比的时候判）。
+    fn format_constant_definitions(
+        format_sources: &[RustSource],
+    ) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<FormatConstantDefinition>> {
+        let mut definitions: BTreeMap<String, Vec<FormatConstantDefinition>> = BTreeMap::new();
+        for source in format_sources {
+            let blanked = blank_comments_and_literals(&source.text);
+            for declaration in declarations_starting_with_word(
+                &blanked,
+                "const",
+                &source.path_from_repository_root,
+            ) {
+                let line_start = blanked
+                    .lines()
+                    .nth(declaration.location.line_number - 1)
+                    .expect("行号由同一份文本数出来");
+                let is_public = line_start
+                    .split_whitespace()
+                    .take_while(|token| *token != "const")
+                    .any(|token| token == "pub");
+                let Some(after_keyword) = declaration.text.strip_prefix("const ") else {
+                    continue;
+                };
+                let Some((name, after_name)) = after_keyword.split_once(':') else {
+                    continue;
+                };
+                let Some((type_name, right_hand_side)) = after_name.split_once('=') else {
+                    continue;
+                };
+                if !is_public || name.trim().starts_with("fn ") {
+                    continue;
+                }
+                definitions.entry(name.trim().to_owned()).or_default().push(
+                    FormatConstantDefinition {
+                        location: declaration.location,
+                        type_name: without_whitespace(type_name),
+                        right_hand_side: right_hand_side
+                            .trim()
+                            .trim_end_matches(';')
+                            .trim()
+                            .to_owned(),
+                    },
+                );
+            }
+        }
+        definitions
+    }
+
+    /// 一条 `assume_specification … ;` 读成什么：`[` 里的路径、`->` 后的交回类型、`returns` 后的字面量。
+    fn read_specification(declaration: DeclarationText) -> SpecificationReading {
+        let unreadable = |reason: &'static str, unread_declaration: DeclarationText| {
+            SpecificationReading::Unreadable {
+                location: unread_declaration.location,
+                reason,
+                text: unread_declaration.text,
+            }
+        };
+        let after_keyword = declaration.text[SPECIFICATION_KEYWORD.len()..].trim_start();
+        if !after_keyword.starts_with('[') {
+            return unreadable("关键字后面不是方括号", declaration);
+        }
+        let Some(close_position) = matching_close_position(after_keyword, 0, '[', ']') else {
+            return unreadable("方括号没有配对", declaration);
+        };
+        let path = without_whitespace(&after_keyword[1..close_position]);
+        let after_path = after_keyword[close_position + 1..].trim_start();
+        let Some(name) = path
+            .strip_prefix(FORMAT_CRATE_PATH_PREFIX)
+            .map(str::to_owned)
+        else {
+            return SpecificationReading::OtherPath {
+                location: declaration.location,
+                path,
+            };
+        };
+        let Some(after_arrow) = after_path.strip_prefix("->").map(str::trim_start) else {
+            return unreadable("方括号后面没写 -> 交回类型", declaration);
+        };
+        let (declared_type, after_type) = if after_arrow.starts_with('(') {
+            let Some(binding_close) = matching_close_position(after_arrow, 0, '(', ')') else {
+                return unreadable("交回值的括号没有配对", declaration);
+            };
+            let Some((_binding_name, binding_type)) = after_arrow[1..binding_close].split_once(':')
+            else {
+                return unreadable("交回值的括号里没写「名字: 类型」", declaration);
+            };
+            (
+                without_whitespace(binding_type),
+                &after_arrow[binding_close + 1..],
+            )
+        } else {
+            let type_end = after_arrow
+                .find(char::is_whitespace)
+                .unwrap_or(after_arrow.len());
+            (
+                without_whitespace(&after_arrow[..type_end]),
+                &after_arrow[type_end..],
+            )
+        };
+        let Some(after_returns) = after_type.trim_start().strip_prefix("returns ") else {
+            return unreadable("没写 returns，规格不交回值", declaration);
+        };
+        let returned_literal = after_returns.trim().trim_end_matches(';').trim().to_owned();
+        SpecificationReading::FormatConstant(FormatConstantSpecification {
+            location: declaration.location,
+            name,
+            declared_type,
+            returned_literal,
+        })
+    }
+
+    /// 一条格式常量规格与 format 那一行比：找得到、是整数字面量、类型与值相同。
+    fn inconsistencies_against_format(
+        specification: &FormatConstantSpecification,
+        definitions: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<FormatConstantDefinition>>,
+    ) -> Vec<SpecificationInconsistency> {
+        let name = specification.name.clone();
+        let matching_definitions = definitions
+            .get(&specification.name)
+            .map_or(&[][..], Vec::as_slice);
+        let definition = match matching_definitions {
+            [] => {
+                return vec![SpecificationInconsistency::ConstantMissingInFormat {
+                    specification: specification.location.clone(),
+                    name,
+                }];
+            }
+            [only_definition] => only_definition,
+            [_, _, ..] => {
+                return vec![
+                    SpecificationInconsistency::ConstantDefinedMoreThanOnceInFormat {
+                        specification: specification.location.clone(),
+                        name,
+                        definitions: matching_definitions
+                            .iter()
+                            .map(|definition| definition.location.clone())
+                            .collect(),
+                    },
+                ];
+            }
+        };
+        let defined_literal = parse_integer_literal(&definition.right_hand_side)
+            .filter(|_literal| INTEGER_TYPE_NAMES.contains(&definition.type_name.as_str()));
+        let Some((defined_value, _defined_suffix)) = defined_literal else {
+            return vec![
+                SpecificationInconsistency::FormatDefinitionIsNotAnIntegerLiteral {
+                    specification: specification.location.clone(),
+                    name,
+                    definition: definition.location.clone(),
+                    type_name: definition.type_name.clone(),
+                    right_hand_side: definition.right_hand_side.clone(),
+                },
+            ];
+        };
+        let mut inconsistencies = Vec::new();
+        if specification.declared_type != definition.type_name {
+            inconsistencies.push(SpecificationInconsistency::TypeDiffersFromFormat {
+                specification: specification.location.clone(),
+                name: name.clone(),
+                which_type: "-> 写的交回类型",
+                specified_type: specification.declared_type.clone(),
+                format_type: definition.type_name.clone(),
+            });
+        }
+        let Some((specified_value, specified_suffix)) =
+            parse_integer_literal(&specification.returned_literal)
+        else {
+            inconsistencies.push(
+                SpecificationInconsistency::ReturnedValueIsNotAnIntegerLiteral {
+                    specification: specification.location.clone(),
+                    name,
+                    returned_literal: specification.returned_literal.clone(),
+                },
+            );
+            return inconsistencies;
+        };
+        if specified_suffix != Some(definition.type_name.as_str()) {
+            inconsistencies.push(SpecificationInconsistency::TypeDiffersFromFormat {
+                specification: specification.location.clone(),
+                name: name.clone(),
+                which_type: "returns 字面量的类型后缀",
+                specified_type: specified_suffix.unwrap_or("（没写后缀）").to_owned(),
+                format_type: definition.type_name.clone(),
+            });
+        }
+        if specified_value != defined_value {
+            inconsistencies.push(SpecificationInconsistency::ValueDiffersFromFormat {
+                specification: specification.location.clone(),
+                name,
+                specified_value,
+                definition: definition.location.clone(),
+                defined_value,
+            });
+        }
+        inconsistencies
+    }

+/// 读写走不走页缓存。真设备上一律绕开（块层计数才与程序数的对得上）；走页缓存的那一臂只给阳性对照用。
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum PageCachePolicy {
+    BypassWithDirectInputOutput,
+    GoThroughPageCache,
+}

+/// 一块按 4096 对齐的暂存区：在多分配 4096 字节的 Vec 里用 `align_offset` 找对齐起点，不写 unsafe。
+struct AlignedScratch {
+    storage: Vec<u8>,
+    start: usize,
+    length: usize,
+}
+
+impl AlignedScratch {
+    /// 对齐起点之后还装得下 `length` 字节。
+    spec fn holds_the_window(&self) -> bool {
+        self.start + self.length <= self.storage@.len() <= usize::MAX
+    }
+
+    // 指针对齐 Verus 验不了：可信，登记进信任清单，差分测试核每一种长度的起点都落在 4096 的整数倍上、窗口装得下。
+    #[verifier::external_body]
+    fn new(length: usize) -> (scratch: Self)
+        ensures
+            scratch.holds_the_window(),
+            scratch.length == length,
+    {
+        let storage = vec![0u8; length + DIRECT_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT];
+        let start = storage.as_ptr().align_offset(DIRECT_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT);
+        assert!(
+            start < DIRECT_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT,
+            "运行期 align_offset 对 u8 指针总给得出偏移；给不出说明这个前提被打破了"
+        );
+        Self {
+            storage,
+            start,
+            length,
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn as_slice(&self) -> (window: &[u8])
+        requires
+            self.holds_the_window(),
+        ensures
+            window@ == self.storage@.subrange(self.start as int, self.start + self.length),
+    {
+        &self.storage[self.start..self.start + self.length]
+    }
+
+    fn as_mut_slice(&mut self) -> (window: &mut [u8])
+        requires
+            old(self).holds_the_window(),
+        ensures
+            window@.len() == old(self).length,
+            final(self).start == old(self).start,
+            final(self).length == old(self).length,
+            final(self).storage@.len() == old(self).storage@.len(),
+    {
+        let end = self.start + self.length;
+        &mut self.storage.as_mut_slice()[self.start..end]
+    }
+}

+/// `O_DIRECT` 后端：打开一个已经存在的块设备（或普通文件），大小取设备末尾的偏移，不改大小。
+pub struct DirectInputOutputBlockDevice {
+    file: File,
+    size_in_bytes: u64,
+    physical_block_size: PhysicalBlockSizeInBytes,
+    policy: PageCachePolicy,
+    discard_outcome_counts: DiscardOutcomeCounts,
+    /// 这个句柄上发出过的改介质动作（[`BlockDevice::issued_operations`]；ghost，产品构建里是零字节的占位）。
+    operations_issued_on_this_handle: Ghost<Seq<IssuedDeviceOperation>>,
+}
+
+impl BlockDevice for DirectInputOutputBlockDevice {
+    closed spec fn issued_operations(&self) -> Seq<IssuedDeviceOperation> {
+        self.operations_issued_on_this_handle@
+    }
+
+    closed spec fn physical_block_size_of_the_device(&self) -> u32 {
+        self.physical_block_size.0
+    }
+
+    closed spec fn size_of_the_device_in_bytes(&self) -> u64 {
+        self.size_in_bytes
+    }
+
+    fn read_at(
+        &self,
+        offset: DeviceOffsetInBytes,
+        buffer: &mut [u8],
+    ) -> (result: Result<(), BlockDeviceError>) {
+        check_aligned_and_in_range(
+            offset,
+            length_of(buffer),
+            self.physical_block_size,
+            self.size_in_bytes,
+        )?;
+        match self.policy {
+            PageCachePolicy::BypassWithDirectInputOutput => {
+                let mut scratch = AlignedScratch::new(buffer.len());
+                if let Err(error) = read_exact_at_the_offset(&self.file, scratch.as_mut_slice(), offset.0) {
+                    return Err(BlockDeviceError::InputOutput(error));
+                }
+                buffer.copy_from_slice(scratch.as_slice());
+                Ok(())
+            }
+            PageCachePolicy::GoThroughPageCache => match read_exact_at_the_offset(&self.file, buffer, offset.0) {
+                Ok(()) => Ok(()),
+                Err(error) => Err(BlockDeviceError::InputOutput(error)),
+            },
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn write_at(
+        &mut self,
+        offset: DeviceOffsetInBytes,
+        bytes: &[u8],
+        durability: WriteDurability,
+    ) -> (result: Result<(), BlockDeviceError>) {
+        check_aligned_and_in_range(
+            offset,
+            length_of(bytes),
+            self.physical_block_size,
+            self.size_in_bytes,
+        )?;
+        self.operations_issued_on_this_handle = Ghost(
+            self.operations_issued_on_this_handle@.push(
+                IssuedDeviceOperation::Write { offset, bytes: bytes@, durability },
+            ),
+        );
+        let written = match self.policy {
+            PageCachePolicy::BypassWithDirectInputOutput => {
+                let mut scratch = AlignedScratch::new(bytes.len());
+                scratch.as_mut_slice().copy_from_slice(bytes);
+                write_all_at_the_offset(&self.file, scratch.as_slice(), offset.0)
+            }
+            PageCachePolicy::GoThroughPageCache => write_all_at_the_offset(&self.file, bytes, offset.0),
+        };
+        if let Err(error) = written {
+            return Err(BlockDeviceError::InputOutput(error));
+        }
+        match durability {
+            WriteDurability::Plain => Ok(()),
+            WriteDurability::ForceUnitAccess => match sync_data_of_the_file(&self.file) {
+                Ok(()) => Ok(()),
+                Err(error) => Err(BlockDeviceError::InputOutput(error)),
+            },
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn write_zeroes_at(
+        &mut self,
+        offset: DeviceOffsetInBytes,
+        length: u64,
+    ) -> (result: Result<(), BlockDeviceError>) {
+        check_aligned_and_in_range(offset, length, self.physical_block_size, self.size_in_bytes)?;
+        self.operations_issued_on_this_handle = Ghost(
+            self.operations_issued_on_this_handle@.push(
+                IssuedDeviceOperation::WriteZeroes { offset, length },
+            ),
+        );
+        // `O_DIRECT` 要求用户缓冲对齐，所以全 0 暂存区走 `AlignedScratch`（它自己就是全 0 的）；
+        // 走页缓存那一臂不需要对齐，但用同一块暂存区，两臂发出的 pwrite 完全一样。
+        let scratch = AlignedScratch::new(zero_fill_chunk_length(length));
+        let file = &self.file;
+        write_zeroes_in_chunks(
+            offset,
+            length,
+            scratch.as_slice(),
+            |chunk_offset: DeviceOffsetInBytes, chunk: &[u8]| -> Result<(), BlockDeviceError> {
+                match write_all_at_the_offset(file, chunk, chunk_offset.0) {
+                    Ok(()) => Ok(()),
+                    Err(error) => Err(BlockDeviceError::InputOutput(error)),
+                }
+            },
+        )
+    }
+
+    /// 第一版不认 discard：核过请求就交回 [`DiscardOutcome::Unsupported`]，一个字节不动、不发系统调用，两臂（绕开 / 走页缓存）一样；
+    /// 长度 0 的照 trait 文档交回 [`DiscardOutcome::Applied`]、不记数。
+    /// 真块设备上的 discard 是 `BLKDISCARD` ioctl，留到真盘线（`research/prompts/m4-gc-r1-main-verification.md` 第三节 G5「真盘 ioctl 留到真盘线」）；
+    /// 在那之前虚机里的设备侧日志里不会有 Discard 条目，宿主重跑那一侧要照这个结局投（checker 档 `device_log.rs`）。
+    fn discard_at(
+        &mut self,
+        offset: DeviceOffsetInBytes,
+        length: u64,
+    ) -> (result: Result<DiscardOutcome, BlockDeviceError>) {
+        check_aligned_and_in_range(offset, length, self.physical_block_size, self.size_in_bytes)?;
+        if length == 0 {
+            // `O_DIRECT` 后端：长度 0 没有动作，交回「交给了底层」、不记数（[`BlockDevice::discard_at`] 的文档）。
+            return Ok(DiscardOutcome::Applied);
+        }
+        self.discard_outcome_counts
+            .note(DiscardOutcome::Unsupported);
+        Ok(DiscardOutcome::Unsupported)
+    }
+
+    fn barrier(&mut self) -> (result: Result<(), BlockDeviceError>) {
+        self.operations_issued_on_this_handle = Ghost(
+            self.operations_issued_on_this_handle@.push(IssuedDeviceOperation::Barrier),
+        );
+        match sync_data_of_the_file(&self.file) {
+            Ok(()) => Ok(()),
+            Err(error) => Err(BlockDeviceError::InputOutput(error)),
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn probe_physical_block_size(&self) -> (physical_block_size: PhysicalBlockSizeInBytes) {
+        self.physical_block_size
+    }
+
+    fn size_in_bytes(&self) -> (device_size: u64) {
+        self.size_in_bytes
+    }
+}

+    /// 排他地建出一个镜像文件并把它撑到 `size_in_bytes`；稀疏文件，不真占盘。
+    /// 同名文件已经在那儿了就报 [`BlockDeviceError::ImageFileAlreadyExists`]，不接着用旧镜像：
+    /// 测试的镜像名带进程号，而进程号会被系统复用、上一轮被杀留下的文件不会被清——接着用就是拿上一轮的盘面当这一轮的起点，
+    /// 而且是静默的（代码三方 m2-supp3-item3-code-r1 判决第四节第 9 题，用户定案）。
+    pub fn create_image_file_exclusively(
+        path: &Path,
+        size_in_bytes: u64,
+        physical_block_size: PhysicalBlockSizeInBytes,
+    ) -> Result<Self, BlockDeviceError> {
+        let file = OpenOptions::new()
+            .read(true)
+            .write(true)
+            .create_new(true)
+            .open(path)
+            .map_err(|error| {
+                if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists {
+                    BlockDeviceError::ImageFileAlreadyExists {
+                        path: path.to_path_buf(),
+                    }
+                } else {
+                    BlockDeviceError::InputOutput(error)
+                }
+            })?;
+        file.set_len(size_in_bytes)
+            .map_err(BlockDeviceError::InputOutput)?;
+        Ok(Self {
+            file,
+            size_in_bytes,
+            physical_block_size,
+            zero_fill_landing: INITIAL_ZERO_FILL_LANDING,
+            zero_fill_landing_counts: NO_ZERO_FILL_LANDED_YET,
+            discard_landing: INITIAL_DISCARD_LANDING,
+            discard_outcome_counts: DiscardOutcomeCounts::NONE,
+            discard_punch_attempts_interrupted_by_signal: 0,
+            operations_issued_on_this_handle: Ghost::assume_new(),
+        })

+                }

+            zero_fill_landing: INITIAL_ZERO_FILL_LANDING,
+            zero_fill_landing_counts: NO_ZERO_FILL_LANDED_YET,

+    /// 差分测试用的镜像：64 KiB、物理块 512。
+    const CONTRACT_IMAGE_BYTES: u64 = 65536;
+    const CONTRACT_PHYSICAL_BLOCK_BYTES: u32 = 512;
+
+    /// 差分测试按次发的请求：对齐落在盘里的、正好到盘尾的、长度 0 的（盘首与盘尾）、偏移没对齐的、长度没对齐的、整段越过盘尾的、
+    /// 跨过盘尾的、偏移加长度越过 `u64` 的。
+    const CONTRACT_REQUESTS: [(u64, u64); 10] = [
+        (0, 512),
+        (4096, 4096),
+        (CONTRACT_IMAGE_BYTES - 512, 512),
+        (0, 0),
+        (CONTRACT_IMAGE_BYTES, 0),
+        (100, 512),
+        (512, 100),
+        (CONTRACT_IMAGE_BYTES, 512),
+        (CONTRACT_IMAGE_BYTES - 512, 1024),
+        (u64::MAX - 511, 512),
+    ];

+    /// 一段写下去的字节：随偏移、长度与第几趟变，挪了位置、少写一截、写成旧的一趟都读得出来。
+    fn contract_pattern(offset: u64, length: u64, round: u8) -> Vec<u8> {
+        (0..length)
+            .map(|index| {
+                let mixed = (offset + index).wrapping_mul(31) ^ length ^ u64::from(round);
+                u8::try_from(mixed % 251).expect("小于 251")
+            })
+            .collect()
+    }
+
+    /// 读回整块盘，与模型逐字节比。
+    fn assert_device_reads_back_as_the_model<Device: BlockDevice>(
+        device: &Device,
+        model: &[u8],
+        label: &str,
+    ) {
+        let mut whole_device = vec![0xEEu8; model.len()];
+        device
+            .read_at(DeviceOffsetInBytes(0), &mut whole_device)
+            .expect("读回整块盘");
+        assert!(
+            whole_device == model,
+            "{label}：读回的盘与按交回 Ok 的写、写零算出来的模型不同（第一处不同在偏移 {:?}）",
+            whole_device
+                .iter()
+                .zip(model)
+                .position(|(read, expected)| read != expected)
+        );
+    }
